Title: Energy Data Engineer - Collaboratori P.IVA
HTML:
Scegliendo Horsa avrai l’opportunità di collaborare con una delle più importanti realtà di consulenza IT del panorama italiano. Siamo specializzati nelle aree ERP, Business Analytics, Technology e nelle aree più innovative come la Cyber Security, il Cloud e la Industry 4.0.

Grazie alla qualità del nostro operato, siamo riconosciuti come Partner d’eccellenza per guidare i processi di trasformazione digitale dei nostri Clienti a respiro nazionale e internazionale.

La persona selezionata lavorerà in provincia di Bergamo.


Posizione

Cerchiamo una figura di Energy Data Engineer con esperienza nel mondo dei dati applicato al settore energetico.

Il candidato sarà coinvolto nello sviluppo di modelli analitici e predittivi per l’analisi delle performance energetiche degli edifici e degli impianti HVAC. Lavorerà a stretto contatto con esperti di dominio, data scientist e sviluppatori per progettare e implementare soluzioni basate su machine learning, digital twin e sistemi di monitoraggio avanzati.


Requisiti

  • Analizzare dati energetici e ambientali degli edifici per identificare pattern, anomalie e opportunità di ottimizzazione;
  • Sviluppare e configurare modelli digitali degli edifici e dei relativi sistemi energetici;
  • Progettare e implementare modelli di simulazione basati su approcci rule-based e algoritmi di machine learning;
  • Supportare l’ottimizzazione delle performance di impianti HVAC, quali pompe di calore, caldaie e unità di trattamento aria;
  • Realizzare dashboard e strumenti di reporting per il monitoraggio delle prestazioni energetiche;
  • Collaborare al rilascio e alla messa in esercizio di modelli analitici e predittivi in ambiente di produzione;
  • Contribuire allo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative per il miglioramento dell’efficienza energetica degli edifici.


Sei la persona giusta per noi se:

  • Hai maturato almeno 4-5 anni di esperienza in ambito Energy Data, Smart Building o Data Analytics;
  • Possiedi una laurea in Ingegneria Energetica, Fisica, Informatica o discipline affini;
  • Hai esperienza nella modellazione energetica di edifici e sistemi HVAC;
  • Conosci strumenti di analisi dati come Excel, Power BI o Tableau;
  • Utilizzi Python e le principali librerie per l’analisi dei dati (Pandas, NumPy);
  • Hai familiarità con l’analisi di serie storiche e algoritmi di machine learning;
  • Possiedi ottime capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di lavoro in team.


Costituiscono un plus:

  • Esperienza con framework Machine Learning (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch);
  • Conoscenza di AWS, Databricks o piattaforme cloud analoghe;
  • Esperienza con sistemi BMS/BEMS e protocolli Modbus o BACnet;
  • Conoscenza di Digital Twin e ontologie per edifici intelligenti;
  • Esperienza nella modellazione di sistemi energetici HVAC.


Altre Informazioni

  • Valutiamo solo collaboratori a P.IVA.
  • Richiesta attività Full Time.
  • Modalità di lavoro ibrida con presenza preferibile di 3 giorni a settimana presso la sede in provincia di Bergamo.
  • Disponibilità: da settembre


La ricerca è rivolta anche a persone appartenenti alle categorie protette L.68/99 Art.1.

Inviare curriculum vitae dettagliato, con l’autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali secondo il Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR).

Ai sensi della normativa vigente l'offerta di lavoro si intende estesa a entrambi i sessi (L 903/77).

Title: Computational Scientist and Bioinformatician
Description:
IFOM is an internationally recognized non-profit cancer research institute supported by the Italian Association for Cancer Research (AIRC), based in Milan within a highly dynamic urban environment.

IFOM's continued success is ensured by the recruitment of highly selected undergraduate, graduate and post-graduate researchers from over 24 countries worldwide.

IFOM is hosted within a research campus shared with the European Institute of Oncology and the Italian Institute of Technology.

IFOM is committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment, based on mutual respect and the enhancement of diversity, offering equal job opportunities to all qualified candidates.




We seek for our Institute: Computational Scientist and Bioinformatician




The successful candidate will join the Computational Oncology and Bioinformatics Unit and report directly to the Head of the Unit. This is a permanent, full-time position with a central role in delivering bioinformatics and computational analyses across strategically relevant institutional, translational and collaborative research programmes at IFOM.

The Unit coordinates bioinformatics and computational medicine activities, promotes the development of advanced analytical platforms, integrates molecular and clinical data, and implements innovative research projects in collaboration with IFOM research groups and external clinical, academic and industrial partners.

The Unit operates as a research and development structure rather than a task-based facility. The candidate will therefore contribute as an integrated scientific partner throughout the research process, from study design and analytical planning to biological interpretation, dissemination and publication.

The Unit aims to generate clinically relevant knowledge and novel therapeutic opportunities by:

integrating genomic, transcriptomic and other molecular data with clinical and phenotypic information;
characterizing tumour evolution, heterogeneity, cellular plasticity, treatment response and resistance;
developing and validating computational methods and reproducible analytical platforms for tissue- and liquid-biopsy studies;
supporting high-priority institutional programmes and collaborative projects with robust, innovative and quantitatively sound analyses.

We are looking for a scientist with at least 3 years of relevant experience in bioinformatics, computational biology or biomedical data science, including doctoral research where applicable.

The candidate will be responsible for:

Designing, implementing and interpreting bioinformatics analyses of next-generation sequencing and multi-omic datasets, including WES/WGS, targeted sequencing, RNA sequencing and liquid-biopsy data.
Developing, validating and maintaining reproducible analytical pipelines, standard operating procedures and documentation, with appropriate QA/QC, version control and testing.
Integrating molecular data with clinical and experimental variables to generate biologically and clinically meaningful results.
Contributing to study design, analytical strategy, statistical planning and the definition of computational endpoints for preclinical, translational and clinical research projects.
Working closely with wet-lab scientists, clinicians, computational researchers and external partners to translate scientific questions into effective analytical solutions.




About the position

Coordinating computational activities across multiple projects, managing priorities, milestones, deliverables and dependencies in agreement with the Head of the Unit.
Communicating analytical approaches and results clearly through technical reports, project meetings, presentations, manuscripts, grant applications and institutional deliverables.
Contributing to the management, optimization and responsible use of servers, HPC resources and data storage in coordination with IFOM IT, RCDS unit and infrastructure teams.
Ensuring secure and compliant handling of research and clinical data in accordance with institutional data-governance policies, GDPR requirements and research ethics.
Providing technical guidance and contributing to the training and mentoring of junior researchers and students.
Developing independent methodological contributions and actively supporting the scientific growth and visibility of the Unit.




Qualification

Strong background in cancer biology and/or computational sciences, with demonstrated experience in translational, biomedical or clinically oriented research contexts.
Solid knowledge of statistics, quantitative methods and sound principles of experimental and observational data analysis.
Demonstrated experience in the analysis of NGS and/or multi-omic data and in the biological interpretation of complex datasets.
Programming skills in Bash, Python and/or R; experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
High confidence in Linux-based systems and command-line environments.
Experience with computational infrastructures, including servers and/or HPC environments, job schedulers, resource management and storage systems.
Experience with reproducible research practices, including workflow automation, version control, code documentation, software testing and containerized environments.
Basic to intermediate knowledge of IT infrastructure and information-security best practices, including user and access management, data protection, backup principles and compliance with data-governance policies.
Proven ability to manage computational analyses across multiple projects, exercise independent scientific judgement and take ownership of technical deliverables.
Ability to communicate analytical choices and results clearly and to work constructively within multidisciplinary teams spanning biology, computation and clinical research.
Flexible, reliable and problem-solving-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt to evolving scientific and project requirements.
Experience with LLM is a plus.




Education

Candidates with a PhD in biology or another life-science discipline will also be considered when supported by a strong and demonstrable computational profile. PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, applied mathematics, statistics or biostatistics, data science, computer or biomedical engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.




Languages

Professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to work effectively in an international scientific environment and communicate technical results.
Experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
Knowledge of Italian is not required but will be considered an advantage.




Soft skills

Scientific curiosity and a rigorous, solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to collaborative research.
Clear and pragmatic communication with colleagues from different scientific and professional backgrounds.
Strong organization, reliability, adaptability and attention to the quality and reproducibility of results.
The ideal candidate should be rigorous and uncompromising when it comes to data quality, while remaining respectful, constructive, and collaborative with colleagues.




What we offer

An international and highly collaborative research environment, continuous training and flexible working time.
Relocation-cost support and a guest house within the campus.
Support for candidates and their families, including housing, schooling, registration with the Italian National Health Service and work-permit procedures, through the IFOM Welcome Office.
Campus facilities and benefits, including a bar and canteen, lunch benefit, company nursery, medical service, laptop, CAF tax-declaration service and agreements with local gyms, pharmacies, psychological services and shops.
Access to Lab G, a laboratory specifically designed for pregnant or breastfeeding researchers.




Contract

Permanent contract, full time.




Location

Milan - Scalo di Porta Romana area




Contact Details

If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your CV and a letter of interest to recruitment(at)ifom.eu and giovanni.crisafulli(at)ifom.eu.

IFOM is committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment, based on mutual respect and the enhancement of diversity, offering equal job opportunities to all qualified candidates.


We seek for our Institute: Computational Scientist and Bioinformatician


The successful candidate will join the Computational Oncology and Bioinformatics Unit and report directly to the Head of the Unit. This is a permanent, full-time position with a central role in delivering bioinformatics and computational analyses across strategically relevant institutional, translational and collaborative research programmes at IFOM.

The Unit coordinates bioinformatics and computational medicine activities, promotes the development of advanced analytical platforms, integrates molecular and clinical data, and implements innovative research projects in collaboration with IFOM research groups and external clinical, academic and industrial partners.

The Unit operates as a research and development structure rather than a task-based facility. The candidate will therefore contribute as an integrated scientific partner throughout the research process, from study design and analytical planning to biological interpretation, dissemination and publication.

The Unit aims to generate clinically relevant knowledge and novel therapeutic opportunities by:

  • integrating genomic, transcriptomic and other molecular data with clinical and phenotypic information;
  • characterizing tumour evolution, heterogeneity, cellular plasticity, treatment response and resistance;
  • developing and validating computational methods and reproducible analytical platforms for tissue- and liquid-biopsy studies;
  • supporting high-priority institutional programmes and collaborative projects with robust, innovative and quantitatively sound analyses.

We are looking for a scientist with at least 3 years of relevant experience in bioinformatics, computational biology or biomedical data science, including doctoral research where applicable.

The candidate will be responsible for:

  • Designing, implementing and interpreting bioinformatics analyses of next-generation sequencing and multi-omic datasets, including WES/WGS, targeted sequencing, RNA sequencing and liquid-biopsy data.
  • Developing, validating and maintaining reproducible analytical pipelines, standard operating procedures and documentation, with appropriate QA/QC, version control and testing.
  • Integrating molecular data with clinical and experimental variables to generate biologically and clinically meaningful results.
  • Contributing to study design, analytical strategy, statistical planning and the definition of computational endpoints for preclinical, translational and clinical research projects.
  • Working closely with wet-lab scientists, clinicians, computational researchers and external partners to translate scientific questions into effective analytical solutions.


About the position

  • Coordinating computational activities across multiple projects, managing priorities, milestones, deliverables and dependencies in agreement with the Head of the Unit.
  • Communicating analytical approaches and results clearly through technical reports, project meetings, presentations, manuscripts, grant applications and institutional deliverables.
  • Contributing to the management, optimization and responsible use of servers, HPC resources and data storage in coordination with IFOM IT, RCDS unit and infrastructure teams.
  • Ensuring secure and compliant handling of research and clinical data in accordance with institutional data-governance policies, GDPR requirements and research ethics.
  • Providing technical guidance and contributing to the training and mentoring of junior researchers and students.
  • Developing independent methodological contributions and actively supporting the scientific growth and visibility of the Unit.


Qualification

  • Strong background in cancer biology and/or computational sciences, with demonstrated experience in translational, biomedical or clinically oriented research contexts.
  • Solid knowledge of statistics, quantitative methods and sound principles of experimental and observational data analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience in the analysis of NGS and/or multi-omic data and in the biological interpretation of complex datasets.
  • Programming skills in Bash, Python and/or R; experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
  • High confidence in Linux-based systems and command-line environments.
  • Experience with computational infrastructures, including servers and/or HPC environments, job schedulers, resource management and storage systems.
  • Experience with reproducible research practices, including workflow automation, version control, code documentation, software testing and containerized environments.
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of IT infrastructure and information-security best practices, including user and access management, data protection, backup principles and compliance with data-governance policies.
  • Proven ability to manage computational analyses across multiple projects, exercise independent scientific judgement and take ownership of technical deliverables.
  • Ability to communicate analytical choices and results clearly and to work constructively within multidisciplinary teams spanning biology, computation and clinical research.
  • Flexible, reliable and problem-solving-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt to evolving scientific and project requirements.
  • Experience with LLM is a plus.


Education

Candidates with a PhD in biology or another life-science discipline will also be considered when supported by a strong and demonstrable computational profile. PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, applied mathematics, statistics or biostatistics, data science, computer or biomedical engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.


Languages

  • Professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to work effectively in an international scientific environment and communicate technical results.
  • Experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
  • Knowledge of Italian is not required but will be considered an advantage.


Soft skills

  • Scientific curiosity and a rigorous, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to collaborative research.
  • Clear and pragmatic communication with colleagues from different scientific and professional backgrounds.
  • Strong organization, reliability, adaptability and attention to the quality and reproducibility of results.
  • The ideal candidate should be rigorous and uncompromising when it comes to data quality, while remaining respectful, constructive, and collaborative with colleagues.


What we offer

  • An international and highly collaborative research environment, continuous training and flexible working time.
  • Relocation-cost support and a guest house within the campus.
  • Support for candidates and their families, including housing, schooling, registration with the Italian National Health Service and work-permit procedures, through the IFOM Welcome Office.
  • Campus facilities and benefits, including a bar and canteen, lunch benefit, company nursery, medical service, laptop, CAF tax-declaration service and agreements with local gyms, pharmacies, psychological services and shops.
  • Access to Lab G, a laboratory specifically designed for pregnant or breastfeeding researchers.


Contract

Permanent contract, full time.


Location

Milan - Scalo di Porta Romana area

If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your CV and a letter of interest to recruitment(at)ifom.eu and giovanni.crisafulli(at)ifom.eu.

Job Description

Stiamo ricercando la seguente figura professionale: AI Architect & Data Science Middle che rappresenti il riferimento tecnico per la progettazione delle soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale e dei modelli analitici avanzati.
Cerchiamo una figura con forte competenza architetturale e di data science, che lavori in prima persona sulla progettazione dei modelli, sulla definizione delle architetture e sulla loro validazione tecnica, collaborando con engineer e data scientist del team.


Progettazione Architetturale
•    Progettare le architetture delle soluzioni AI, Machine Learning e Data Science, assicurando coerenza con gli standard tecnici e le best practice di settore.
•    Disegnare architetture dati basate su paradigmi Lakehouse e, ove rilevante, Data Mesh, per abilitare casi d’uso analitici avanzati.
•    Definire e documentare i pattern architetturali per l’adozione di soluzioni Generative AI (RAG, Vector Search, Lakehouse AI, Mosaic AI, AI Agent).
•    Valutare tecnologie, framework e piattaforme per lo sviluppo e il deployment di modelli AI/ML, producendo analisi comparative e raccomandazioni tecniche.
•    Redigere specifiche tecniche e linee guida per garantire riproducibilità, versionamento e qualità dei modelli.


Data Science Hands-on
•    Progettare e sviluppare modelli di Machine Learning, Deep Learning e NLP per casi d’uso industriali (manutenzione predittiva, ottimizzazione reti, anomaly detection).
•    Condurre analisi esplorative, feature engineering e selezione dei modelli più appropriati per ciascun caso d’uso.
•    Validare la correttezza e la robustezza dei modelli sviluppati dal team, eseguendo review tecniche e test di qualità.
•    Integrare LLM (open source e commerciali) e AI Agent nelle pipeline aziendali, occupandosi della progettazione e della validazione.
•    Assicurare la conformità alle best practice MLOps: monitoraggio del model drift, A/B testing, retraining.
•    Contribuire alla creazione di una knowledge base tecnica interna, documentando pattern, soluzioni e lesson learned.

Competenze Tecniche

Requisiti:
•    Esperienza di 4 – 6  anni in ruoli di AI/ML Architect, Senior Data Scientist o Applied Scientist su progetti complessi in contesti enterprise.
•    Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Statistica, Fisica o discipline affini.
•    Solida conoscenza di algoritmi di Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP e tecniche statistiche avanzate.
•    Esperienza approfondita con piattaforme cloud (Microsoft Azure, Databricks) e architetture Lakehouse.
•    Ottima conoscenza di Python e dei principali framework ML/AI (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face).
•    Esperienza con PySpark e tecnologie Big Data (Apache Spark, Delta Lake).
•    Conoscenza di strumenti MLOps (MLflow, Unity Catalog) e pratiche di CI/CD per modelli ML.
•    Esperienza con LLM, Generative AI e pattern architetturali come RAG e Vector Search.
•    Conoscenza di SQL e dei principi di modellazione dati (star schema, snowflake, granularità, relazioni).
•    Familiarità con strumenti di Data Governance e Data Quality (Unity Catalog, lineage, catalogazione).
•    Certificazioni Databricks o Microsoft Azure in ambito AI/ML. (Nice to Have)
 

Ulteriori competenze
•    Visione architetturale e capacità di tradurre requisiti complessi in soluzioni tecniche concrete.
•    Capacità di comunicare scelte architetturali a interlocutori con diversi livelli di tecnicità.
•    Pensiero analitico e approccio scientifico rigoroso alla risoluzione dei problemi.
•    Disponibilità al confronto tecnico e alla review tra pari.
•    Curiosità verso le tecnologie emergenti e aggiornamento continuo.
•    Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
•    Disponibilità a periodiche trasferte, se necessarie.

Cosa Offriamo
•    Opportunità di crescita professionale in un contesto data-driven in forte espansione.
•    Ambiente di lavoro innovativo nel settore Data & AI.
•    Formazione continua sulle tecnologie emergenti (Databricks, Azure, GenAI).

Job Description

Come Expert Data & AI Scientist farai parte della funzione Digital Information Technologies di Eni e sarai una figura di riferimento all'interno del Centro di Eccellenza Data & AI. Opererai nell'intersezione tra strategia di business e tecnologie di intelligenza artificiale di ultima generazione (Foundation Models, GenAI, sistemi agentici), guidando la progettazione, lo sviluppo e la messa in produzione di soluzioni AI ad alto valore aggiunto.

Attività Principali


Tradurre obiettivi di business in casi d'uso AI prioritizzati su impatto, fattibilità, rischio e ROI
Effettuare il design di soluzioni scegliendo metodologia, approcci e tecnologie più adatte
Definire metriche di successo e framework di valutazione end-to-end definendo le metriche e gli obiettivi
Costruire sistemi agentici e applicazioni di AI Generativa integrando metodologie moderne ed approcci emergenti, implementando guardrail e meccanismi di sicurezza nel ciclo di vita della soluzione e collaborare con i team di engineering per il rilascio in produzione
Definire strategie di lifecycle management per modelli e prompt: retraining, A/B testing, rollback, gestione delle versioni dei foundation model di terze parti
Garantire la conformità all'EU AI Act supportando le valutazioni di conformità e collaborando con Compliance, Legal e DPO e producendo la documentazione tecnica adeguata
Presentare risultati a stakeholder eterogenei (C-level, business, tecnici) con storytelling efficace, data visualization e capacità di gestire aspettative su ciò che l'AI può e non può fare
Supportare la crescita di data scientist junior e mid-level, definire best practice e standard tecnici del CoE. Partecipare attivamente alla community aziendale Data & AI con attività di knowledge sharing, contributi a Medium / blog tecnici, partecipazione a conferenze e contribuire al posizionamento dell'azienda sulle tematiche AI.


Caratteristiche Richieste


Laurea magistrale in discipline STEM: Matematica, Fisica, Statistica, Computer Science, Ingegneria, Data Science; sarà valutato positivamente un dottorato nell’ambito
Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Data Scientist / ML Engineer / AI Engineer, con almeno 1 anno di esperienza su soluzioni Generative AI / LLM in produzione
Track record di progetti AI portati end-to-end dalla discovery al deployment, con misurazione dell'impatto di business
Padronanza di Python e dell'ecosistema scientifico (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn)
Solida conoscenza teorica e pratica di algoritmi supervisionati, non supervisionati, ensemble methods, time series, deep learning
Competenza in statistica e conoscenza dei metodi sperimentali: inferenza, A/B testing, causal inference, design degli esperimenti, metodologie necessarie per valutare sistemi GenAI e processi di NLP tramite costruzione di metriche e benchmark
Conoscenza SQL avanzato, esperienza di lavoro con dati strutturati e non strutturati, vector store, basi di data engineering
Esperienza pratica di consumo di modelli commerciali e open-weight e nella realizzazione di applicazioni pratiche con l’utilizzo di tecniche di Context Engineering e RAG
Conoscenze di metodologia MLOps e utilizzo di strumenti a supporto
Esperienza di sviluppo di modelli e applicazioni di AI su almeno un major cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP) tramite servizi AI gestiti (Bedrock, Azure ML/AI Foundry, Vertex AI).

San Donato Milanese

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
SDG Group is looking for AI Engineers, motivated professionals with 1 to 3 years of experience in AI & ML, to join our AI & ML Engineering team.

From day one, you will be fully integrated into an international delivery unit, working with multicultural teams on high-impact projects across cutting-edge and highly competitive sectors such as Fashion & Luxury, Utilities, Banking, Insurance, and Healthcare.

This role is ideal for candidates eager to grow fast in a dynamic, international, and constantly evolving environment, with direct exposure to Generative AI and advanced Machine Learning projects.




Your Challenges:

Full-Lifecycle AI Development: Manage the entire journey of an AI solution, from initial problem-solving and data cleaning to building production-ready systems.
Cutting-Edge Modeling: Implement a wide range of algorithms—from traditional statistical optimization and predictive modeling (supervised/unsupervised) to advanced Generative AI using LLMs and Transformers.
Industrialization & AIOps: Transition models from local environments to the cloud using an engineering mindset. You will ensure systems are scalable and reliable by applying AIOps methodologies.
Cloud Mastery: Work across the "Big Three" (AWS, GCP, and Azure) and leverage specialized platforms like Databricks, SageMaker, and Vertex AI to handle large-scale data science needs.
Strategic Insight & Communication: Translate complex datasets into actionable business insights. You will act as a bridge between technical data and client needs, presenting findings that solve real-world challenges.
Collaborative Deployment: Work in synergy with Data Engineers to integrate models into live systems, ensuring they are not just "smart" but operational.




Requirements:

Education: Master’s degree in a STEM field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, or related).
Experience: Professionals with 1 to 3 years of experience in AI / ML / Data Science are a strong fit.
Programming: Proficiency in Python and its ecosystem (NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn).
Technical Foundations: Familiarity with Git, virtual environments, and SQL/NoSQL databases.
Machine Learning / AI Basics: Understanding of core ML concepts (regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction) or experience with Generative AI: LLMs, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, OpenAI API, LangChain, vector databases.
Languages: Fluency in Italian (C1 level) and proficiency in English. Please note that language skills will be tested during the interview process.




Rock your future with SDG:

Continuous Growth & Learning: Access our Internal Academies for 80 hours of initial training, followed by ongoing coaching and support for top-tier certifications (AWS, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, etc.) to keep you at the forefront of AI innovation.
A Meritocratic Ecosystem: Forget rigid structures. We offer semi-annual performance reviews to discuss your achievements, new challenges, and salary adjustments based on your results.
High-Impact Projects: From Day 1, you’ll be part of a team implementing real-world AI, deep learning, and predictive analytics for global industry leaders across multiple sectors.
Young & International Culture: Join a diverse, inclusive, and energetic team with an average age under 30, where you’ll rub shoulders with top AI experts and enjoy opportunities for international travel.




What we offer:

Contract: Permanent contract (CCNL Commercio).
Salary: Indicative Gross Annual Salary (RAL) ranging from €28,000 to €36,000. Positioning within this range will be determined based on technical skills, specific role experience, and interview outcomes, following objective and predefined criteria. (For exceptional profiles falling outside this range, a salary revision may be evaluated subject to internal approval).
Work Mode: Total flexibility. 100% remote, hybrid, or in-office. You decide where and how you work best.
Other Benefits: Supplementary health insurance, meal vouchers (Ticket Restaurant), and a structured corporate welfare plan.







About SDG Group: Working at SDG means joining one of the fastest-growing management consulting firms globally in the fields of Business Analytics, Corporate Performance Management, and Advanced Business Solutions. With more than 2,500 professionals worldwide, SDG has been recognized by Gartner as a leader and one of the 37 most cutting-edge companies in the Data & Analytics sector—the only Italian firm and the second in Europe. SDG operates in Italy with 3 offices (Milan, Florence, Verona) and has branches in Spain, Portugal, France, the UK, the USA, and the Middle East. We put our analytics expertise at the service of companies to empower their business strategies, helping them transform into successful data-driven organizations.

Are you ready to be part of the future of AI? Apply now!

Title: Data Engineer – AI & Data Products
Description:
The Data Technologies, Analytics & BI Solutions team is responsible for designing, building, and operating scalable Data, AI, and Cloud platforms, enabling reliable, reusable, and business-driven solutions at scale.




Working in a tech-driven environment, the team partners with internal IT functions (e.g., Innovation & AI Forge) to transform validated initiatives into robust, scalable, and production-ready products.




The selected candidate will:

Design and develop cloud-native data pipelines for analytics, AI, and data-driven applications
Build and optimize batch and streaming data ingestion into modern data lakehouse architectures
Ensure data quality, reliability, observability, and governance by design
Support AI/ML workflows by developing feature stores, preprocessing pipelines, and training datasets
Contribute to GenAI and advanced AI use cases through optimized data architectures
Develop backend data services and APIs for production environments
Collaborate with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to industrialize models using MLOps and CI/CD practices
Work with Platform Engineering and SRE teams to ensure scalability, monitoring, and cost optimization
Contribute to the evolution of the cloud data platform architecture
Ensure security, privacy, and compliance (especially for financial data)
Stay up to date on emerging trends (GenAI, real-time analytics, data mesh, AI platforms)




Requirements

3 years of experience in Data Engineering or ML Engineering
Programming skills (Python, SQL, or Scala; experience with PySpark is a plus)
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and data storage technologies
Hands-on experience with distributed frameworks (e.g., Spark)
Knowledge of data modeling and data governance concepts
Experience with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker)
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field




What we offer




The role is offered within the 3^Area Professionale category, under the National Collective Labour Agreement for the Banking Sector (CCNL Credito) and the applicable Company Collective Agreement (Contratto Integrativo Aziendale).




The starting gross annual salary is €37.000. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s professional experience and the technical and interpersonal competences required for the position and may include an individual variable compensation component.




Additional benefits include:

Health insurance coverage
Supplementary pension scheme
Corporate welfare plan
Hybrid working arrangements (Smart‑working)
Meal vouchers
Preferential access to Group products and services
Training programs and Learning platforms
Opportunities for internal and international mobility




Why Choose Generali




Joining Generali means becoming part of an international Group with a strong heritage and a forward-looking vision, where people are at the center of our sustainable growth strategy.




We foster a responsible, inclusive, and innovation-driven work environment, where everyone can contribute to creating value for customers, society, and the communities in which we operate. We believe that diversity, equity and inclusion are essential to building a stronger culture and driving sustainable growth.




At Generali, you will find opportunities to grow through continuous learning, career development paths, and internal mobility across the Group. We recognize talent and merit, and support flexibility as a key enabler of well-being and a sustainable work-life balance.




Working with us means sharing strong values and taking on meaningful challenges together to build a safer and more sustainable future every day.




As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Generali evaluates all applications based exclusively on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including skills, experience and potential, ensuring fairness and transparency throughout the selection process.




Company Profile

Generali is a major player in the global insurance industry - a strategic and highly important sector for the growth, development and welfare of modern societies. Over almost 200 years, we have built a multinational Group that is present in more than 60 countries, with 470 companies and nearly 80,000 employees. Our Group aims to become the standard bearer and industry leader in the European retail insurance market, building on our existing base of 50 million retail clients, out of an overall total of 72 million.




Generali Asset Management is a European investment specialist, offering a wide range of active funds and bespoke solutions across both public and private markets. Our investment experience is grounded in a solid heritage, with skills that have been developed and honed over time by managing Generali Group and external clients' assets.




Generali Asset Management S.p.A. guarantees a solid framework of services designed to support various asset management activities. Key elements include the provisioning of IT services over all applications underpinning the investment and asset management value chain (Front Office, Trading Desk, Investment Compliance, Middle and Back Office, Analytics and Reporting, etc.) The company also acts as a holding company, retaining share capital in the boutiques and Generali Investments’ companies.

Joining Generali means becoming part of an international Group with a strong heritage and a forward-looking vision, where people are at the center of our sustainable growth strategy.


We foster a responsible, inclusive, and innovation-driven work environment, where everyone can contribute to creating value for customers, society, and the communities in which we operate. We believe that diversity, equity and inclusion are essential to building a stronger culture and driving sustainable growth.


At Generali, you will find opportunities to grow through continuous learning, career development paths, and internal mobility across the Group. We recognize talent and merit, and support flexibility as a key enabler of well-being and a sustainable work-life balance.


Working with us means sharing strong values and taking on meaningful challenges together to build a safer and more sustainable future every day.

Company Profile

Generali is a major player in the global insurance industry - a strategic and highly important sector for the growth, development and welfare of modern societies. Title: Graduate data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discounted price. Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able to receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Title: Data Platform & AI Engineer
Description:
Entrando in Accenture Supply Chain & Engineering lavorerai al cuore della value chain - dal sourcing e procurement, all'engineering e R&D, dalla manifattura e operations, ai capital projects - per aiutare le aziende a reinventare l'intera catena del valore, alimentata da dati, AI e tecnologie di nuova generazione.

In particolare, lavorerai su progetti di implementazione tecnologica e trasformazione digitale su larga scala, traducendo esigenze di business in software scalabili ad alto impatto operativo, integrando sviluppo software, ingegneria industriale, architettura tecnologica e site reliability, end-to-end.

Siamo alla ricerca di profili Data Platform & AI Engineer interessati a lavorare su progetti in cui il dato rappresenta la base per costruire soluzioni intelligenti, scalabili e ad alto impatto sul business. Entrerai a far parte di iniziative end-to-end in cui dati provenienti da sistemi, applicazioni, impianti, macchine e processi vengono raccolti, trasformati e valorizzati per abilitare analytics avanzati, Generative AI, Machine Learning e soluzioni agentiche. Cerchiamo professionisti pragmatici, curiosi e orientati alla delivery, capaci di muoversi tra tecnologia e valore di business, con la voglia di lavorare su dati reali, sistemi complessi e use case concreti, contribuendo alla realizzazione di soluzioni Data Platform, Analytics e AI in grado di generare un impatto tangibile per i clienti.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive



Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni Data Platform & AI su cloud e architetture moderne

Integrare dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee (database, API, sistemi industriali, applicazioni enterprise e dispositivi)

Realizzare e mantenere pipeline ETL/ELT e processi di data ingestion e trasformazione

Contribuire alla creazione di dataset, modelli dati, semantic layer e data product a supporto di analytics e AI

Supportare attività di troubleshooting, ottimizzazione e miglioramento continuo delle piattaforme dati

Collaborare con Data Architect, AI Engineer, Business Analyst e stakeholder di business

Utilizzare strumenti di Generative AI per accelerare attività di analisi, sviluppo, testing e documentazione



La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è prevista l’applicazione del CCNL Metalmeccanico, con uno tra i seguenti livelli di inquadramento e corrispondente fascia di retribuzione annua lorda:

B1 30.814,29€ e 40.800€

B2 33.058,74€ e 50.500€

B3 36.906,87 € e 65,800€

Le tue caratteristiche



2-6 anni di esperienza in uno o più dei seguenti ambiti: Data Engineering, Data Platform, Cloud Analytics, AI Engineering

Esperienza con piattaforme dati moderne, cloud data platform, data lake, data warehouse o architetture lakehouse

Conoscenza di tecnologie quali Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Spark, SQL, Python, dbt o strumenti equivalenti

Capacità di lavorare con dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee e di supportarne la trasformazione, modellazione e valorizzazione

Familiarità con temi di data quality, governance, sicurezza e gestione del ciclo di vita del dato

Interesse verso Generative AI, Machine Learning, RAG, semantic search e agentic workflows

Attitudine al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione con stakeholder tecnici e di business



Costituiscono un plus



Esperienza nei settori Manufacturing, Industrial, Supply Chain, Quality o Operations

Familiarità con ERP, MES, sistemi qualità o soluzioni IoT

Esperienza in progetti di trasformazione data-driven e AI-enabled

Capacità di collegare dati, processi e risultati di business

Esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni scalabili e industrializzabili

Interesse verso innovazione, sperimentazione e utilizzo dell'AI come acceleratore del lavoro quotidiano

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Posizione : Data Analyst

Sede : San Vittore Olona – Milano

Tipo di Impiego : Tempo pieno

Settore / Divisione : IT

RAL: Da definire

Livello : Livello intermedio (5-8 anni)

Tipo di Contratto: Tempo Indeterminato

Riporto : Global IT Manager / Data Lead

Area Operativa: Data & Analytics







Panoramica

Chematek è in forte espansione nella propria infrastruttura dati: stiamo costruendo un moderno data stack su Snowflake e Azure, integrando fonti ERP, CRM e operative provenienti da più paesi. Cerchiamo un Data Analyst con solide basi su data warehousing e una concreta voglia di crescere verso ML e AI applicata al business.




L’azienda

Chematek è un distributore di servizi tecnici, integrati e industriali, focalizzato sui settori della chimica fine, della petrolchimica, dell’ingegneria, approvvigionamento e costruzione (EPC) e dei lubrificanti. Opera attraverso 9 centri geografici ben integrati, con sede centrale nel Nord Italia.

Chematek è un’azienda a proprietà privata, attiva da oltre 40 anni. La società ha la missione di sviluppare i mercati e commercializzare prodotti differenziati e di eccellenza nei propri settori di riferimento, garantendo al contempo un servizio e una consegna eccellenti, solidi e affidabili alla propria ampia clientela globale.




Descrizione del ruolo

La risorsa lavorerà a stretto contatto con il Data Lead e con i partner di implementazione, partecipando attivamente alla costruzione e all’evoluzione della piattaforma dati aziendale.




Mansioni e responsabilità

Progettare e mantenere modelli dbt su Snowflake in collaborazione con il Data Lead
Costruire e ottimizzare pipeline ADF per l’ingestion da Business Central, HubSpot, Xero e altri sistemi operativi
Sviluppare report e dashboard su Power BI per le divisioni aziendali
Applicare modelli ML su dati aziendali per supportare analisi predittive e ottimizzazione operativa
Garantire qualità, documentazione e governance dei dati (GDPR); collaborare con i partner IT esterni nelle fasi di knowledge transfer







Requisiti del candidato

5–8 anni di esperienza in ruoli analitici (data analyst, BI developer, data engineer)
Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Statistica, Matematica o equivalente
Snowflake – modellazione, query optimization, cost monitoring, RBAC di base
SQL avanzato – window functions, CTE, ottimizzazione query su larga scala
Azure – Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage / ADLS Gen2, ambienti cloud-native
dbt (data build tool) – modelli, tests, documentazione, lineage
Python – pandas, numpy, scripting di automazione e data prep
Power BI o Tableau (almeno uno a livello operativo; conoscenza dell’altro apprezzata)
Data modeling – star schema, dimensioni SCD, data vault di base
Plus apprezzati: ML applicato (scikit-learn), Azure ML / Azure AI Services, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
Italiano ed inglese fluente scritto e parlato (ambiente internazionale)
Disponibilità a lavorare in full presence – San Vittore Olona, Milano




Prego inviare cv a : careers@chematek.com

HTML:
Vuoi essere al centro di prospettive di crescita uniche?

Entra all’interno del team di Customer di PwC e diventa:

Customer Data Scientist | Senior Associate

Your Perspectives 

Ti unirai al gruppo di Customer di PwC su sfidanti progetti di Customer Advance Analytics, Data Science e Generative AI in ambito Consumer Markets, Financial Services, Energy&Utilities e Telco&Media, per supportare le organizzazioni nel valorizzare il patrimonio informativo sui propri Clienti e Consumatori finali, utilizzando i dati a disposizione per sviluppare soluzioni innovative basate su AI.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Retail Merchandising
Description:
If you’ve worn a pair of glasses, we’ve already met.

We are a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames, and sunglasses. We offer our industry stakeholders in over 150 countries access to a global platform of high-quality vision care products (such as the Essilor brand, with Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest and Transitions), iconic brands that consumers love (such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear and Costa), as well as a network that offers consumers high-quality vision care and best-in-class shopping experiences (such as Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò and the GrandVision network), and leading e-commerce platforms.

Join our global community of over 190,000 dedicated employees around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry.

Discover more by following us on LinkedIn !

Your #FutureInSight with EssilorLuxottica

Are you willing to pioneer new frontiers, foster inclusivity and collaboration, embrace agility, ignite passion, and make a positive impact on the world? Join us in redefining the boundaries of what’s possible.

Your role

We are looking for an experienced and business-driven Senior Data Scientist with a strong passion for data, analytics and AI. This role is ideal for a professional who enjoys leading end-to-end data science initiatives, shaping the analytical strategy, and enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization, with a focus on Retail and the DTC Category Management & Merchandising domain.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and Machine Learning expertise with leadership capabilities, and is able to translate complex data into strategic insights for Retail. You will work closely with business, Corporate AI and BI stakeholders, playing a key role in bridging data and decision-making, and driving the evolution of advanced analytics AI capabilities within the DTC Category Management & Merchandising organization.

Main Responsibilities


Design, develop, and deploy advanced data science and AI solutions, including machine learning models, forecasting, optimization algorithms, and intelligent systems
Develop AI-powered tools and applications (e.g., recommendation systems, forecasting models, decision engines) tailored to retail and assortment use cases
Explore and implement Generative AI and agent-based solutions to enhance business processes and customer experience, in collaboration with the Corporate AI team
Lead end-to-end data science projects, from problem framing and data exploration to model deployment and monitoring on Databricks (PySpark, MLflow)
Translate complex business problems into scalable analytical and AI solutions with measurable impact.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities for innovation and experimentation
Work closely with Corporate Data & AI teams to ensure robust and scalable implementation of solutions
Continuously evaluate and adopt new technologies, tools, and methodologies.
Contribute to building best practices, frameworks, and reusable components for advanced analytics and AI development
Act as a senior individual contributor and informal mentor, supporting knowledge sharing within the team
Development of tracking dashboards to Monitor Adoption of our Tools/Solutions


Main Requirements


Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related fields
Solid experience (typically 4–7+ years) in data science / AI roles with hands-on end-to-end project delivery.
Strong programming skills in Python and experience with Data Science and ML frameworks (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch).
Advanced knowledge in SQL and relational and lakehouse data models.
Proven experience in building and deploying machine learning models in production environments on Databricks (PySpark, MLflow)
Experience with advanced analytics techniques (e.g., forecasting, optimization, NLP, recommendation systems)
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently drive complex initiatives end-to-end, including mentoring more junior colleagues.
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions with tangible impact
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong collaborator and teamwork member, reference for mentoring more junior colleagues by sharing best practices and knowledge.


Nice To Have


Experience in retail analytics or customer-centric use cases (e.g., assortment planning, demand forecasting, personalization) in the eyewear or luxury industry
Familiarity with Generative AI and developing multi-agent systems, with exposure to experiment design.
Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools (CI/CD, model monitoring, feature stores, versioning)
Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Azure preferred) and optimization solvers.
Experience with data modelling techniques (e.g., medallion architecture, Kimball dimensional modelling)
Proven experience in building and operating data pipelines in production environments on Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog)
Experience with real-time data applications and data visualization with Python (Plotly, Streamlit) or BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI
Product-oriented mindset or experience working in innovation labs / fast-paced environments

In EssilorLuxottica, you are not defined just by your job title. Each career adventure is unique; have a glimpse of some of the benefits you will enjoy as a successful candidate:


Access to our cutting-edge learning platform, Leonardo, and personalized development programs to help you grow professionally and personally.
Enjoy flexible work conditions, health insurance coverage, ticket restaurants, internal rooftop canteen.
Access special offers for employees on a vast range of eyewear, eye care products, and fashion apparel, so you can enjoy our world-class brands firsthand.
Enjoy our “Disconnect Program” a holistic approach to work-life balance, including initiatives for mental health, yoga, jogging sessions, and more, designed to help you recharge and stay healthy.

Title: Computational Scientist and Bioinformatician
Description:
IFOM is an internationally recognized non-profit cancer research institute supported by the Italian Association for Cancer Research (AIRC), based in Milan within a highly dynamic urban environment.

IFOM's continued success is ensured by the recruitment of highly selected undergraduate, graduate and post-graduate researchers from over 24 countries worldwide.

IFOM is hosted within a research campus shared with the European Institute of Oncology and the Italian Institute of Technology.

IFOM is committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment, based on mutual respect and the enhancement of diversity, offering equal job opportunities to all qualified candidates.




We seek for our Institute: Computational Scientist and Bioinformatician




The successful candidate will join the Computational Oncology and Bioinformatics Unit and report directly to the Head of the Unit. This is a permanent, full-time position with a central role in delivering bioinformatics and computational analyses across strategically relevant institutional, translational and collaborative research programmes at IFOM.

The Unit coordinates bioinformatics and computational medicine activities, promotes the development of advanced analytical platforms, integrates molecular and clinical data, and implements innovative research projects in collaboration with IFOM research groups and external clinical, academic and industrial partners.

The Unit operates as a research and development structure rather than a task-based facility. The candidate will therefore contribute as an integrated scientific partner throughout the research process, from study design and analytical planning to biological interpretation, dissemination and publication.

The Unit aims to generate clinically relevant knowledge and novel therapeutic opportunities by:

integrating genomic, transcriptomic and other molecular data with clinical and phenotypic information;
characterizing tumour evolution, heterogeneity, cellular plasticity, treatment response and resistance;
developing and validating computational methods and reproducible analytical platforms for tissue- and liquid-biopsy studies;
supporting high-priority institutional programmes and collaborative projects with robust, innovative and quantitatively sound analyses.

We are looking for a scientist with at least 3 years of relevant experience in bioinformatics, computational biology or biomedical data science, including doctoral research where applicable.

The candidate will be responsible for:

Designing, implementing and interpreting bioinformatics analyses of next-generation sequencing and multi-omic datasets, including WES/WGS, targeted sequencing, RNA sequencing and liquid-biopsy data.
Developing, validating and maintaining reproducible analytical pipelines, standard operating procedures and documentation, with appropriate QA/QC, version control and testing.
Integrating molecular data with clinical and experimental variables to generate biologically and clinically meaningful results.
Contributing to study design, analytical strategy, statistical planning and the definition of computational endpoints for preclinical, translational and clinical research projects.
Working closely with wet-lab scientists, clinicians, computational researchers and external partners to translate scientific questions into effective analytical solutions.




About the position

Coordinating computational activities across multiple projects, managing priorities, milestones, deliverables and dependencies in agreement with the Head of the Unit.
Communicating analytical approaches and results clearly through technical reports, project meetings, presentations, manuscripts, grant applications and institutional deliverables.
Contributing to the management, optimization and responsible use of servers, HPC resources and data storage in coordination with IFOM IT, RCDS unit and infrastructure teams.
Ensuring secure and compliant handling of research and clinical data in accordance with institutional data-governance policies, GDPR requirements and research ethics.
Providing technical guidance and contributing to the training and mentoring of junior researchers and students.
Developing independent methodological contributions and actively supporting the scientific growth and visibility of the Unit.




Qualification

Strong background in cancer biology and/or computational sciences, with demonstrated experience in translational, biomedical or clinically oriented research contexts.
Solid knowledge of statistics, quantitative methods and sound principles of experimental and observational data analysis.
Demonstrated experience in the analysis of NGS and/or multi-omic data and in the biological interpretation of complex datasets.
Programming skills in Bash, Python and/or R; experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
High confidence in Linux-based systems and command-line environments.
Experience with computational infrastructures, including servers and/or HPC environments, job schedulers, resource management and storage systems.
Experience with reproducible research practices, including workflow automation, version control, code documentation, software testing and containerized environments.
Basic to intermediate knowledge of IT infrastructure and information-security best practices, including user and access management, data protection, backup principles and compliance with data-governance policies.
Proven ability to manage computational analyses across multiple projects, exercise independent scientific judgement and take ownership of technical deliverables.
Ability to communicate analytical choices and results clearly and to work constructively within multidisciplinary teams spanning biology, computation and clinical research.
Flexible, reliable and problem-solving-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt to evolving scientific and project requirements.
Experience with LLM is a plus.




Education

Candidates with a PhD in biology or another life-science discipline will also be considered when supported by a strong and demonstrable computational profile. PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, applied mathematics, statistics or biostatistics, data science, computer or biomedical engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.




Languages

Professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to work effectively in an international scientific environment and communicate technical results.
Experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
Knowledge of Italian is not required but will be considered an advantage.




Soft skills

Scientific curiosity and a rigorous, solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to collaborative research.
Clear and pragmatic communication with colleagues from different scientific and professional backgrounds.
Strong organization, reliability, adaptability and attention to the quality and reproducibility of results.
The ideal candidate should be rigorous and uncompromising when it comes to data quality, while remaining respectful, constructive, and collaborative with colleagues.




What we offer

An international and highly collaborative research environment, continuous training and flexible working time.
Relocation-cost support and a guest house within the campus.
Support for candidates and their families, including housing, schooling, registration with the Italian National Health Service and work-permit procedures, through the IFOM Welcome Office.
Campus facilities and benefits, including a bar and canteen, lunch benefit, company nursery, medical service, laptop, CAF tax-declaration service and agreements with local gyms, pharmacies, psychological services and shops.
Access to Lab G, a laboratory specifically designed for pregnant or breastfeeding researchers.




Contract

Permanent contract, full time.




Location

Milan - Scalo di Porta Romana area




Contact Details

If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your CV and a letter of interest to recruitment(at)ifom.eu and giovanni.crisafulli(at)ifom.eu.

Permanent contract, full time.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Il nostro obiettivo è sempre stato quello di creare e ampliare nel tempo un gruppo di persone qualificato, affidabile e disponibile; puntando su professionisti esperti, ma anche sulla formazione, investendo risorse nella crescita professionale.Dipendenti e collaboratori attraverso consolidate competenze tecniche, contribuiscono a rendere Craon un’azienda altamente qualificata e competitiva sul mercato ICT.

Per unprogetto enterprise siamo alla ricerca di un Data Engineer con 2-5 anni di esperienza nella progettazione, realizzazione e gestione di pipeline dati scalabili, affidabili e ad alte prestazioni.

La risorsa entrerà a far parte di un team specializzato e contribuirà allo sviluppo di moderne piattaforme dati, occupandosi dell'integrazione, trasformazione e ottimizzazione dei flussi informativi, garantendo qualità, affidabilità e performance delle soluzioni implementate.

Responsabilità

La risorsa sarà coinvolta nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di pipeline dati, nella realizzazione di processi ETL/ELT, nell'integrazione di dati provenienti da sistemi eterogenei e nell'ottimizzazione delle performance delle piattaforme dati. Collaborerà con Data Engineer, Data Scientist, Software Engineer e stakeholder di progetto per supportare la realizzazione di soluzioni scalabili e orientate al business.

Requisiti tecnici

È richiesta una buona esperienza nello sviluppo con Python e/o Scala, unita a una solida conoscenza di SQL e dei principali database relazionali, quali PostgreSQL e MySQL.

Sono richieste competenze nell'utilizzo di piattaforme Big Data, in particolare Apache Spark, Hadoop, Hive e distribuzioni Cloudera, oltre a una buona conoscenza delle architetture dati e dei processi ETL/ELT.

Il candidato ideale possiede esperienza con ambienti Cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure o Google Cloud Platform) e con i principali servizi dedicati alla gestione dei dati, quali BigQuery, Amazon Redshift o servizi equivalenti. È inoltre richiesta familiarità con strumenti di orchestrazione dei workflow e delle pipeline dati.

Saranno considerate un plus la conoscenza di database NoSQL, come MongoDB e Cassandra, l'esperienza con tecnologie di containerizzazione quali Docker e Kubernetes, la familiarità con pipeline CI/CD, con strumenti di versionamento come Git e con i principali concetti di Data Warehouse e modellazione dei dati.

Soft Skills


Capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari.
Orientamento al problem solving e alla scalabilità delle soluzioni.
Autonomia nello sviluppo, ma con attitudine alla collaborazione



Sede: Milano/Torino ibrido

Offriamo contratto a tempo indeterminato (CCNL Commercio e Servizi) con RAL compresa tra 25.000 € e 35.000 €, da definire sulla base dell'esperienza professionale e delle competenze maturate.

Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91 e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.

Title: Data Scientist
HTML:
Votre mission

En tant que Data Scientist, vous rejoignez notre équipe R&D et avez pour mission de développer des solutions d’IA pour optimiser nos outils métiers de conception et de dimensionnement des ouvrages. Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

  • Développement de modèles d’IA pour améliorer la précision et l’efficacité des processus de conception et de dimensionnement ;
  • Préparation et nettoyage des données pour les rendre exploitables par les algorithmes d’IA ;
  • Intégration des modèles d’IA dans nos outils métiers existants, potentiellement via des projets de recherche innovants ;
  • Collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie et d’architecture pour comprendre leurs besoins et proposer des solutions adaptées ;
  • Veille technologique pour identifier les nouvelles tendances et innovations en matière d’IA et de data science.

Votre profil

  • Vous disposez d’un master ou d’un doctorat en data science, intelligence artificielle, ingénierie, mathématiques appliquées, ou domaine connexe ;
  • Vous avez quelques années d’expérience en data science et intelligence artificielle, dans le développement de modèles de machine learning et de deep learning, ainsi que dans l’intégration de modèles d’IA dans des applications métiers ;
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils de traitement de données (Python, R, SQL, etc.) et les méthodes de préparation et de nettoyage des données ;
  • Vous avez des compétences de communication et de pédagogie nécessaires au partage de votre savoir ;
  • Vous êtes animé(e) par la recherche de solutions techniques innovantes et parfaitement adaptées ;
  • Vous êtes sensible aux domaines de l’architecture et de la construction ;
  • Vous appréciez le travail collaboratif et vous impliquer dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire ;
  • La connaissance du néerlandais et/ou de l’anglais est un plus.


Nous vous proposons de

  • Travailler sur une grande variété de projets ;
  • Faire évoluer vos responsabilités et élargir votre champ de compétences ;
  • Rejoindre une équipe dans laquelle l’ambiance de travail a toute son importance, et où l’humain est au cœur des réflexions et le bien-être au cœur des décisions ;
  • Intégrer un bureau d’études qui agit concrètement en faveur du développement durable et l’opportunité de participer à ses objectifs de responsabilité sociétale ;
  • Disposer d’un package salarial en ligne avec votre expérience et des avantages extra-légaux : assurance hospitalisation, assurance décès, assurance pension, budget mobilité, congés d’ancienneté, plan cafétéria.


Votre lieu de travail

  • Liège (Angleur), dans le cadre verdoyant du Liège Science Park

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
As a Data Scientist, you'll join a forward-thinking Sports Analytics company leveraging data and AI to redefine how teams analyse performance, and develop strategies. You'll build advanced predictive models and analytics solutions that turn complex sports data into actionable insights, enabling smarter decisions across performance, scouting, and business operations.




Responsibilities

Develop and deploy machine learning models for player performance analysis, injury prediction, match outcome forecasting, fan engagement, and customer analytics.
Analyse large, complex datasets including player tracking, wearable sensor, event, video-derived, and historical performance data to generate actionable insights.
Design predictive models and statistical analyses to optimise player recruitment, tactical decision-making, and performance monitoring.
Build interactive dashboards and visualisations to communicate insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Evaluate model performance and continuously improve algorithms through experimentation and feature engineering.




Your Profile

2–5 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Statistics, or a related field.
Strong Python and SQL skills.
Hands-on experience developing predictive models using libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Experience working with large structured and unstructured datasets and performing statistical analysis.
Knowledge of feature engineering, experimentation, forecasting, clustering, and model evaluation techniques.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP is an advantage.
Familiarity with data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Plotly is beneficial.
Experience within Sports Analytics, HealthTech, wearable technology, performance analytics, or fan engagement platforms is considered a strong plus.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to both technical and business stakeholders.




The Offer

Hybrid working with offices based in Mechelen.
Opportunity to build innovative data science solutions within the rapidly growing Sports Analytics industry.
Work with cutting-edge datasets including player tracking, wearable sensor, performance, and fan engagement data.
Strong investment in technical development, conferences, certifications, and career progression.
Competitive salary package of up to €6,000, depending on experience.
Company car or mobility budget.
Meal vouchers, group and hospitalisation insurance, and additional holiday allowance.
Clear progression opportunities into Senior Data Scientist, Lead Data Scientist, AI Specialist, or Head of Data.
Collaborative and innovation-driven team working at the intersection of sport, data, and artificial intelligence.




If this opportunity excites you, apply today or send your CV and a short cover letter to ryan.martin@vividresourcing.com.

Sopra Steria offers tailored, end-to-end corporate technology and software solutions to help clients make bold choices and deliver results. Successfully so! With more than 56.000 colleagues in 30 countries, we rank as Europe’s leading digital solutions provider. Some of the most successful companies in Europe rely on our technology due to our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and value in business development.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Job Description

Are you brimming with fresh ideas to lead our Data Science team in providing data-driven solutions to our customers based on the latest machine learning models and deep learning algorithms? If you are looking for a new challenge with a steep learning curve, and the support of a dynamic team, you may be our next Data Scientist.

As a Data Scientist, you will dive into the world of artificial intelligence. You will apply your skills to real scenarios and in different domains, such as drug discovery in healthcare, fraud detection in banks, the development of recommendation systems in the retail sector, and more.

Qualifications

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

You are fully convinced that data science isn’t a hype, but you also believe that, in order to be valuable and really make a company smarter, it must be done right. Your goal is therefore to create the most impactful solution possible in the quickest and easiest way possible so that real value can be extracted from data and artificial intelligence.

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:


At least 3+ years of experience in Data Science.
Master's degree (or equivalent through experience) in a field that is highly data-driven.
Experience with some of the following data science techniques: supervised and unsupervised learning models, deep learning, anomaly detection, recommender systems, natural language processing, computer vision and reinforcement learning.
Well versed in open-source software and libraries in Python and/or R for machine and deep learning.
Extensive experience in building and implementing advanced analytics solutions backed up with some reference cases.
Experience with big data and platforms such as Azure Machine Learning Services and Amazon SageMaker is a plus.
Experience in one of the following languages: Python, R, Spark, Scala, Java or C++.
You are resident in Belgium and look forward to working a few days a week at the client's office.
You're fluent in Dutch or French, have a strong grasp of the other, and speak English fluently as well.

As a member of one of Europe’s largest digital solutions providers, you’ll benefit from extensive career development opportunities, both local and international. At the Sopra Steria Academy, you’ll be part of a dynamic network of 56,000 professionals at all stages of their careers.
