You’ll become a part of a major Tech player in Europe recognized for its consulting, digital services, and software development. On top of that, you’ll join the OptimAi Team: the partner for advanced, intelligent solutions using AI.

Additional Information

Our employees are known for making bold choices and delivering results. Work among high-level professionals at the forefront of corporate software solutions and innovation at Europe’s Leading Digital Service Provider.  

We offer a generous employee benefits package that includes:


A company car or mobility budget
Laptop, phone & phone subscription
A competitive salary and indefinite contract
Insurance coverage, meal vouchers, eco-cheques, and more
Continuous learning opportunities through the Sopra Steria Academy to support your career development


People are the cornerstone of our success. That’s why we aspire to be bolder together. Our goal is to build high-functioning teams and healthy team environments that inspire and help each other to deliver excellence for each of our customers.  

Excited about this job opportunity? Ready to shape the world with us? Great! We are looking forward to your application!

ENGIE, a global leader in low-carbon energy and services, relies on its Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management (GBU S&EM) to provide reliable, sustainable, and affordable energy to all its customers. This strategic unit optimizes the Group’s and clients’ production assets and designs tailored energy solutions for our 200,000 professional clients and 15 million consumers.

The Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management leverages ENGIE’s assets to deliver secure and sustainable energy to its B2B and B2C customers. It uses its expertise in energy management to provide decarbonized electricity 24/7.

Joining Supply & Energy Management means becoming part of a team of over 10,000 passionate experts spread across 20 countries, all united by a shared mission: shaping a greener and more efficient energy future. Together, we push the boundaries of innovation to deliver decarbonized energy 24/7. Join us and be part of those shaping the energy of tomorrow!

Context

The Expertise Center Market Analysis and the Business Platform Power Trading, Structuring & Origination (PTSO) are looking for a Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power to join the Short-Term Power Market Analysis (STP) team in Brussels. The position sits on the trading floor, embedded in an extended team of market analysts, meteorologists, hydrologists and data scientists.

The STP team covers short-term power markets — week-ahead, day-ahead, intraday, ancillary and imbalance — in support of trading and portfolio management activities in Central Western Europe (CWE). Weather has become the dominant driver of these markets: renewable generation, demand and prices are increasingly shaped by it, and extracting value from weather information is one of the team’s key priorities.

This is not a conventional power analyst position. We are looking for a data scientist with strong weather expertise, or a quantitative meteorologist, to act as a bridge between two teams: as a member of the STP team, the successful candidate will also be integrated in the Meteo & Climate team, strengthening the collaboration between them. Above all, the candidate will work in close daily contact with our internal clients: the short-term power trading and asset optimization desks.

Your Mission

As Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power, your mission is to turn weather data into market value: translating weather forecasts — and their uncertainty — into actionable signals, forecasts and strategies for the short-term power trading and asset optimization desks.

Your main activities:


Develop, industrialize and maintain weather-driven forecast products and trading signals for day-ahead, intraday and imbalance markets, owning the full model lifecycle from research to production.
Exploit deterministic and ensemble weather forecasts (post-processing, calibration, skill evaluation) to extract predictive value for renewable generation, demand and prices in CWE.
Work daily with the trading desks: understand their needs, deliver weather intelligence in actionable form, and communicate forecast confidence and risks clearly and on time.
Act as the bridge between the STP and Meteo & Climate teams: co-develop tools and data pipelines, spread weather best practices within STP, and bring power market awareness to the weather team.
Monitor upcoming weather and alert traders and analysts on market-moving weather events and forecast revisions.
Contribute to the team’s roadmap, dashboards and digital platforms, staying ahead of advances in weather forecasting, data science and AI.


Hard Skills

What we are looking for


In-depth knowledge of Numerical Weather Prediction models and weather data, including ensemble forecasting and reanalysis datasets.
Strong Python and data science skills: machine learning applied to time series, statistical post-processing, uncertainty quantification, and handling of large meteorological datasets.
Experience building, deploying and maintaining models in production; familiarity with cloud-based technologies (AWS, GCP or Azure) is a plus.
Knowledge of (short-term) power markets is a plus — a strong appetite to learn them is a must.


Soft Skills


Clear and effective communication, written and verbal: able to convey complex weather and model topics to traders and non-specialists.
Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset — you will operate across two teams and several desks.
Reactivity, autonomy and composure in a fast-paced trading-floor environment.
Curiosity, creativity and a solution-oriented attitude.


Education & Experience


Master’s degree or PhD in meteorology, atmospheric sciences, physics, applied mathematics, engineering or a related field.
3 to 5 years of experience in weather forecasting, data science applied to weather, or quantitative analysis — ideally in the energy sector.


Languages


Fluent in English.
French and/or Dutch is a plus.


Why join us?


A unique position at the crossroads of weather science and power trading, with direct daily exposure to trading decisions.
Integration in two expert teams — Short-Term Power and Meteo & Climate — with genuine intellectual depth and a strong collaborative culture.
Access to best-in-class weather data, proprietary data infrastructure and high-performance computing environments.
Autonomy, real responsibilities and the possibility to grow, learn and develop, including attendance to conferences.

Our mission is to make online business success simpler, by providing our customers with all the tools and resources they need to excel online and remain ahead of the curve.

Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Applied Data Scientist who thrives at the intersection of AI, product thinking, and innovation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing Data Science & ML algorithms to solve complex, real-world business problems across the team.blue group. This role requires strong analytical skills, programming, problem solving and data wrangling skills, good communication abilities, and up-to-date knowledge of the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments.

Responsibilities:


Break down multi-domain business problems with a strong focus on return on investment and impact metrics, and think through the appropriate technical methods from POC to production
Develop solutions and extract insight from data using data science and classical machine learning methods and generative AI (GenAI)
Take ownership of developing, implementing, and automating robust data science and ML models and pipelines, including feature generation, modeling, evaluation, retraining and deployment
Translate sophisticated analytical findings and model outcomes into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, demonstrably driving value and improvements in key business metrics
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver innovative Data Science/ML/AI solutions
Conduct research on the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments and apply them to improve our systems
Document processes, code, and findings for future reference and knowledge sharing



Required Skills:


8+ years hands-on industry experience solving data science and machine learning problems to address real-world business problems across multiple verticals
Expert programming skills in Python and SQL and with relevant Data Science & ML frameworks (Scikit-learn, Pandas, PyTorch, etc)
Ability to think through problems from fundamental principles and operate with a high degree of independence and autonomy while bringing clarity to under-specified problems
Deep understanding of statistical and ML algorithms, methodologies and approaches ranging from SVMs to deep learning & LLMs
Ability to own the end to end of the lifecycle of ML/AI projects from conception to containerization
History of hands-on ownership & implementer of projects that have been put in production and made an impact
Experience in applying statistical concepts (e.g. regressions, A/B tests, clustering, probability) to business problems
Strong problem-solving skills with excellent verbal & written communication and the ability to craft analysis into well-written and persuasive content
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams



Nice to have skills


Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, AI, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related fields.
Deep understanding of current DataOps & MLOps practices, deploying and monitoring models and ETL (extract, transform and load) pipelines
Experience with AI/ML R&D
Experience across startups and enterprise firms
Experience with distributed data tools (e.g. Spark, Dask, Apache Arrow), observability frameworks (OTel)

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

Working closely with a cross-functional team of data scientists, data engineers, product developers, and analytics-focused consultants, your core responsibility involves collaborating with product management to build performant, robust, and maintainable analytics products that adhere to established data-science approaches and best practices.

You will expand your expertise across various analytics topics, encompassing descriptive analytics as well as the design, development, and refinement of statistical models, optimization techniques, advanced machine learning, and predictive models like boosted trees.

Furthermore, driving the fine-tuning and evaluation of LLMs requires leveraging the latest advancements in neural network architectures and machine learning techniques, optimizing their performance and efficiency particularly for segmentation use cases. Accelerating this development and problem-solving process involves utilizing cutting-edge GenAI tools such as Claude and Cursor, alongside implementing efficient development and maintenance workflows (MLOps) within our Databricks platform.

Translating these complex data analyses into actionable analytical insights directly guides client project directions, while simultaneously fueling your contributions to internal knowledge sharing, research, and technical documentation focused on unstructured data, LLMs, and predictive modeling. Ultimately, all these efforts converge to bring advanced analytics capabilities into one of the firm's flagship products, "Wave" serving as the backbone for how McKinsey runs future transformations and utilizing powerful data science assets to dramatically improve the odds of success for our clients.

You will work in our McKinsey Client Capabilities Network in EMEA and will be part of our Wave Transformatics team.

Wave is a McKinsey SaaS product that equips clients to successfully manage improvement programs and transformations. Focused on business impact, Wave allows clients to track the impact of individual initiatives and understand how they affect longer term goals. It is a mix of an intuitive interface and McKinsey business expertise that gives clients a simple and insightful picture of what can otherwise be a complex process by allowing them to track the progress and performance of initiatives against business goals, budget and time frames.

Our Transformatics team builds data and AI products to provide analytics insights to clients and McKinsey teams involved in transformation programs across the globe. The current team is composed of 3 data engineers, 5 data scientists,1 analyst and 2 PMs who are spread across several geographies. The team covers a variety of industries, functions, analytics methodologies and platforms – e.g. Cloud data engineering, advanced statistics, machine learning, predictive analytics, MLOps and generative AI.

Your Qualifications and Skills


MSc or PhD level in the field of computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics or equivalent by experience
1+ years of experience in data science, statistical modelling (e.g. advanced regressions, clustering, classification models) and machine learning techniques (e.g. random forest, support vector machines, gradient boosting, XGBoost)
Programming experience in the following languages: Python and SQL. Basic understanding of PySpark
Comfortable leveraging the latest GenAI tools (such as Cursor or Claude) to accelerate coding, debugging, and problem-solving.
Experience with version control using Git and collaborative development workflows in GitHub (e.g., branching, pull requests, code reviews, and repository management)
Experience collaborating on projects to deploy advanced analytics and data science methods in real-world organizations (CI/CD, deployment observation, etc...)
Familiarity with LLMs agents, RAG systems, prompt engineering, machine learning libraries (scikit-learn) or deep learning libraries (TensorFlow/PyTorch) is a plus
Exposure to tools like Databricks and Tableau is a plus
Effective communication skills, including a readiness to break down analytical concepts, methods, and results for non-technical stakeholders. (e.g. consultants, etc...)

  • Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
  • A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
  • Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  • World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

Working closely with a cross-functional team of data scientists, data engineers, product developers, and analytics-focused consultants, your core responsibility involves collaborating with product management to build performant, robust, and maintainable analytics products that adhere to established data-science approaches and best practices.

You will expand your expertise across various analytics topics, encompassing descriptive analytics as well as the design, development, and refinement of statistical models, optimization techniques, advanced machine learning, and predictive models like boosted trees.

Furthermore, driving the fine-tuning and evaluation of LLMs requires leveraging the latest advancements in neural network architectures and machine learning techniques, optimizing their performance and efficiency particularly for segmentation use cases. Accelerating this development and problem-solving process involves utilizing cutting-edge GenAI tools such as Claude and Cursor, alongside implementing efficient development and maintenance workflows (MLOps) within our Databricks platform.

Translating these complex data analyses into actionable analytical insights directly guides client project directions, while simultaneously fueling your contributions to internal knowledge sharing, research, and technical documentation focused on unstructured data, LLMs, and predictive modeling. Ultimately, all these efforts converge to bring advanced analytics capabilities into one of the firm's flagship products, "Wave" serving as the backbone for how McKinsey runs future transformations and utilizing powerful data science assets to dramatically improve the odds of success for our clients.

You will work in our McKinsey Client Capabilities Network in EMEA and will be part of our Wave Transformatics team.

Wave is a McKinsey SaaS product that equips clients to successfully manage improvement programs and transformations. Focused on business impact, Wave allows clients to track the impact of individual initiatives and understand how they affect longer term goals. It is a mix of an intuitive interface and McKinsey business expertise that gives clients a simple and insightful picture of what can otherwise be a complex process by allowing them to track the progress and performance of initiatives against business goals, budget and time frames.

Our Transformatics team builds data and AI products to provide analytics insights to clients and McKinsey teams involved in transformation programs across the globe. The current team is composed of 3 data engineers, 5 data scientists,1 analyst and 2 PMs who are spread across several geographies. The team covers a variety of industries, functions, analytics methodologies and platforms – e.g. Cloud data engineering, advanced statistics, machine learning, predictive analytics, MLOps and generative AI.

Your Qualifications and Skills

  • MSc or PhD level in the field of computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics or equivalent by experience
  • 1+ years of experience in data science, statistical modelling (e.g. advanced regressions, clustering, classification models) and machine learning techniques (e.g. random forest, support vector machines, gradient boosting, XGBoost)
  • Programming experience in the following languages: Python and SQL. Basic understanding of PySpark
  • Comfortable leveraging the latest GenAI tools (such as Cursor or Claude) to accelerate coding, debugging, and problem-solving.
  • Experience with version control using Git and collaborative development workflows in GitHub (e.g., branching, pull requests, code reviews, and repository management)
  • Experience collaborating on projects to deploy advanced analytics and data science methods in real-world organizations (CI/CD, deployment observation, etc...)
  • Familiarity with LLMs agents, RAG systems, prompt engineering, machine learning libraries (scikit-learn) or deep learning libraries (TensorFlow/PyTorch) is a plus
  • Exposure to tools like Databricks and Tableau is a plus
  • Effective communication skills, including a readiness to break down analytical concepts, methods, and results for non-technical stakeholders. (e.g. consultants, etc...)

Title: Data Scientist (Space ISR & AI) for NATO with security clearance
Description:
Would you like to join the leading international intergovernmental organization?

This position supports the SHAPE J2 Capability Development (J2 CapDev) in collaboration with the NCIA CTO's Data & AI Center of Excellence (Data & AI CoE). The role is embedded within the AI Opportunities & Solutions Cell to advance space-based Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) workflows and Related Intelligence Capability Programme Plans (CPPs).

Responsibilities:

Geospatial and ISR data science:


Analyse near- and long-term AI opportunities with clear operational value for space-based ISR workflows.
Prepare and curate labelled datasets for assessments, demonstrations, and analysis initiatives.
Recommend methods to strengthen data collection and management to enhance space-based intelligence workflows
Conduct monthly training sessions to educate stakeholders and end users on AI and geospatial data science.
Provide technical/logistical assistance to showcase AI tools and progress during Demo Day or program demonstrations.
Evaluate analytics capabilities and recommend actionable reports for improvement.
Perform a review of emerging AI technologies and recommend applications for NATO's ISR capabilities.
Shared resource: SHAPE J2 Capability Development (J2 CapDev) and NCIA CTO's Data & Ai Center of Excellence (Data & Ai CoE).


Essential Qualifications & Experience:

Data Scientist for AI Opportunities & Solutions Cell for space based Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) and Related Intelligence Capability Programme Plans (CPPs).

Educational Background:


A nationally recognized or certified university degree in data science, mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, or a related field.
Exceptionally, candidates without a university degree may qualify if they possess significant expertise (minimum 3 years) relevant to the role and duties.


Experience:


3+ years working on AI for imagery or geospatial analysis in production or mission environments (industry, government, or defence).
Demonstrated expertise in artificial intelligence/machine learning workflows, including data labelling, preparation, and processing for large-scale imagery or geospatial datasets.
Experience developing and delivering training and demo materials to mixed technical/non-technical audiences.


Technical skills:


Python (NumPy, Pandas) and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Data visualization tools/techniques.


Additional competencies:


Ability to lead ideation sessions, build rapid ML prototypes, and translate operational needs into measurable model/evaluation requirements.
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles.


Language Proficiency:


Fluent in Business English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.


Soft Skills:


Strong problem-solving abilities.
Excellent teamwork, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Experience interacting effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
High motivation with flexibility and adaptability to new challenges.
Creativity

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Brussel
Description:
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

AI- & ML-solution development


Machine learning- en deep learning-modellen (inclusief generative AI) inzetten om complexe bedrijfsproblemen op te lossen.
Modellen optimaliseren voor prestaties, schaalbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie in Azure-cloudomgevingen.
MLOps-pijplijnen implementeren om modeltraining, validatie en uitrol te automatiseren.



Cloud- & AI-infrastructuur


Schaalbare AI-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden op Azure-cloudplatformen, gebruikmakend van diensten zoals Azure ML en AKS.
Zorgen voor veilige, conforme en hoog-beschikbare AI-implementaties in de cloud.



Generatieve AI & Innovatie


Generative AI-modellen (LLM’s, enz.) verkennen en integreren voor toepassingen zoals: RAG, intelligent document processing, speech-to-text en conversational AI.
Vooroplopen in AI-trends (bijv. fine-tuning, multimodal AI) en innovatieve use cases voorstellen.



Data- & modelgovernance


Zorgen voor datakwaliteit, bias-mitigatie en ethische AI-praktijken bij modelontwikkeling.
Modelmonitoring en explainability-tools implementeren om prestaties en compliance te volgen.



Samenwerking & stakeholder engagement


Samenwerken met productteams, data scientists en zakelijke stakeholders om AI-kansen te identificeren.
Zakelijke vereisten vertalen naar technische AI-oplossingen en inzichten effectief communiceren.



De job in een notendop

Je speelt een centrale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde AI- en machine learning-oplossingen die innovatie en automatisering binnen de organisatie stimuleren.

Je werkt samen met cross-functionele teams om cloudgebaseerde AI-diensten, generatieve AI en schaalbare ML-infrastructuur te benutten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-modellen robuust, ethisch verantwoord en afgestemd zijn op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met:


Een master of doctoraat in de wetenschappen met uitstekende academische resultaten op technisch gebied (econometrie, computerwetenschappen, artificiële intelligentie, e.a.).
Deskundigheid op het vlak van
machine learning technieken en bereidheid om die kennis up-to-date te houden; een diepgaande kennis van algoritmes zoals Random Forests, Neural Networks en reinforcement learning is hierbij een must.
genAI: prompt engineering, structured outputs, ...(zie verantwoordelijkheden).

Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL.
Uitgebreide kennis van Nederlands of Frans, met passieve kennis van de andere taal, en Engels.
Ervaring in het verklaren van complexe analyses aan een niet-technisch publiek aan de hand van je verhalende competenties en je capaciteit om data te visualiseren; je beschikt over uitmuntende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden op technisch en businessniveau.
Honger naar kennis, niet alleen om nieuwe algoritmes en technologieën te beheersen, maar ook op interpersoonlijk vlak; je bent je ervan bewust dat de waarde van jouw werk neerkomt op kwaliteit x acceptatie en je wilt sleutelen aan beide aspecten.
Uitzonderlijke probleemoplossende vaardigheden: je weet dat het juiste inzicht in een probleem minstens 90% van de oplossing uitmaakt, je geeft blijk van creativiteit en volharding bij het doorgronden van problemen en het zoeken van oplossingen.


Je scoort extra met:


Tweetaligheid (Engels en Nederlands of Frans).
Ervaring met het bouwen van dataproducten, van ontwerp tot productie.
Wat full-stack skills.
Kennis van cloud, bij voorkeur Azure.



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

Title: Data Scientist (Senior)
Description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our Data & Analytics team. As a Data Scientist you will not only bring technical expertise but also a deep understanding of business operations and strategy. Your work will directly influence decision-making and help shape the future of our organization through actionable insights drawn from complex datasets.

As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business leaders, product managers, and engineers, to design and implement data-driven solutions that align with the company’s goals. You will be expected to translate complex data into business value, leveraging machine learning, predictive modeling, and statistical analysis.

Key Responsibilities:


Business Insight Development: Understand the key business challenges and opportunities, and use data to develop solutions that align with strategic objectives.
Data Strategy: Collaborate with leadership to define the data science roadmap and priorities based on business needs and opportunities.
Predictive Modeling & Machine Learning: Build, deploy, and maintain machine learning models to forecast trends, optimize processes, and drive business outcomes.
Data Analysis & Visualization: Analyze large, complex datasets to extract actionable insights, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Data science pipeline: Advise, build and continuously improve the data science pipeline which best responds to team.blue analytics needs.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with business leaders, product teams, and engineers to ensure that data solutions meet business requirements.
Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest trends in data science, AI, and machine learning to continuously improve the team’s capabilities.



Requirements:


Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data science, with a proven track record of solving complex business problems using data.
Strong understanding of business operations and the ability to align data science projects with business objectives.
Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical insights into business recommendations and communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
Problem-solving: Strong analytical thinking with the ability to handle complex and unstructured data.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Scala.
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
Experience with SQL and working with large data sets.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and big data tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).



"Come as you are"

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
As a Data Scientist, you will be part of a global team supporting the development and manufacturing of innovative biologic medicines. Leveraging advanced statistics and data science, you will help optimize processes, drive scientific decision-making, and generate actionable insights from complex datasets. You will collaborate closely with experts across Manufacturing, Process Development, and Analytical Sciences to support both operational excellence and innovation initiatives.



Key Responsibilities


Provide statistical and data science support for process optimization, validation, monitoring, and investigations.
Collect, structure, analyze, and interpret complex datasets to deliver meaningful business and scientific insights.
Design and execute experimental studies (DoE) to support data-driven decision-making.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for technical and cross-functional stakeholders.
Contribute to protocols, reports, and technical documentation with significant statistical content.
Act as a subject matter expert in statistics and data science, providing guidance across multiple functions.
Ensure data integrity, reliability, and compliance within a regulated environment.
Support digital transformation and advanced analytics initiatives across manufacturing operations.


Profile


Master's degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related scientific discipline.
Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry.
Strong expertise in statistical methodologies and modern data science techniques.
Experience with biologics development, manufacturing processes, or process development is an asset.
Familiarity with GMP environments and regulatory requirements is highly desirable.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus.


What Can You Expect?


A challenging role within a leading global pharmaceutical organization.
The opportunity to contribute to the development and manufacturing of life-changing medicines.
Exposure to cutting-edge technologies in data science, digital transformation, and advanced analytics.
Collaboration with international experts across multiple disciplines and manufacturing sites.
A dynamic and innovative environment that encourages continuous learning and professional growth.
The chance to make a tangible impact on patients through data-driven scientific excellence.


To find out more about Computer Futures please visit www.computerfutures.com

Title: Senior Data Science Analyst - OptimusAI
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Data Science Specialist, you’ll collaborate in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team of 3–6 experts, using your creativity and analytics expertise to drive client performance in areas like energy efficiency, product quality, and capacity. You’ll work side-by-side with client process engineers and analytics specialists, presenting your insights directly to executive audiences.

Internally, you’ll partner with our talented product engineers to develop innovative products and algorithms that address both current and future client needs. You’ll play a key role in codifying best practices, amplifying our impact both inside and outside the firm, and shaping the product roadmap.

You’ll be based in our Brussels office as part of McKinsey’s manufacturing AI solution, OptimusAI, which sits at the intersection of three practices: Global Energy and Materials, QuantumBlack, and Operations.

Global Energy and Materials: Advises production and investor companies across chemicals & agriculture, paper & packaging, metals & mining, oil & gas, and power generation on strategic, operational, and growth issues.

QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey: The AI arm of our firm, helping clients transform faster, innovate smarter, and anticipate the future.

Operations: Assists clients in solving complex operational challenges by developing and implementing strategies and solutions for their most critical problems—connecting boardroom strategies to shop floor operators.

At the intersection of these groups, OptimusAI is a team of ~10 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on improving processing plant productivity through data analytics. We develop real-time AI advisory systems to support decision making in plant control rooms, optimize process control systems, and unlock plant bottlenecks through data-driven process changes.

OptimusAI also supports a global community of consultants by developing an innovative machine learning toolkit and codifying our approach to deliver significant and lasting client impact.

You’ll benefit from world-class training in business problem structuring and client advisory, working closely with senior manufacturing and analytics experts. Experience unparalleled career growth, with significant ownership and responsibility from day one, all within a collaborative, diverse, and non-hierarchical environment. Plus, seize the opportunity to travel to client sites—locally and around the world.

There is a flexibility to hire at different role level, depending on your experience.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in advanced analytics, ideally within heavy industry environments
Advanced Python programming skills, with a passion for writing clean, efficient, modular, and maintainable code
Proven ability to implement and maintain MLOps pipelines for seamless model integration and deployment
Strong DevOps and backend engineering capabilities, including experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible)
Self-starter with excellent organizational abilities—able to independently initiate tasks and drive them to completion
Skilled in making rational, data-driven decisions based on facts and logical reasoning
Ability to create high-quality work products, such as PowerPoint presentations, Excel models, articles, or other written outputs
Exceptional time management skills to thrive in a complex, largely autonomous work environment
Willingness to work or attend meetings outside traditional business hours, and to take on projects at short notice when needed
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English with the ability to tailor your style to different audiences and seniority levels

Title: Data Scientist - Banking
Description:
Data Scientist – Financial Services

About NORRIQ

NORRIQ is an international organization headquartered in Denmark and Belgium, with over 350 consultants dedicated to driving business transformation through innovative technology.

Our Financial Services (FS) practice includes 100+ specialists helping banks and financial institutions adapt to evolving client expectations, leverage cutting-edge technologies, and navigate increasingly complex regulatory environments.

At NORRIQ, we believe that people are our greatest asset. We foster a culture of innovation, growth, and excellence, offering tailored training, clear career paths, and a strong sense of community. Join us on this exciting journey and become a valued member of the NORRIQ family — connected for life!

The Opportunity

NORRIQ Financial Services is looking for a Data Scientist to accelerate our data analytics, machine learning, and generative AI initiatives. You will work with leading financial institutions to design, build, and deliver data-driven and AI-powered solutions that create tangible business impact.

Roles & Responsibilities

Client-Facing Responsibilities


Design and implement machine learning and generative AI solutions for complex financial use cases.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and build insightful dashboards or visualizations.
Present analytical findings and actionable recommendations to senior management and stakeholders.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Data Engineers, Business Analysts, Developers) to industrialize AI solutions.
Provide technical guidance and advisory on data science and AI best practices.


Technical Responsibilities


Develop and maintain AI and ML models using Python, scikit-learn, and deep learning frameworks.
Apply a wide range of analytical methodologies, including:
Generative AI techniques (Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-tuning, Speech-to-Text, Agentic Applications, Image Generation & Interpretation)
Predictive AI and classical machine learning approaches.
Contribute to production-grade AI applications using tools such as GitLab, DVC, and MLOps frameworks.
Ensure reproducibility, version control, and performance optimization across models and pipelines.
Create and maintain Jupyter notebooks for experimentation and documentation.

Internal Contributions


Contribute to NORRIQ’s AI & Data Science Center of Excellence through knowledge sharing and internal projects.
Support proposal writing and solution architecture for client engagements.
Stay at the forefront of developments in data science, AI, and GenAI frameworks (LangChain, Haystack, etc.).


Our Data Scientist Must Have


Fluency in English, and Dutch or French, with at least passive knowledge of the other
Belgian residency
At least few years of experience in a similar role.


What NORRIQ Offers You


Be part of a fast-growing, international organization with a unique and people-centered culture
Enjoy a highly competitive compensation package, including a company car, iPhone, and additional allowances
Access extensive training programs in Belgium and Denmark, focusing on both technical expertise and soft skills
Work with a dynamic and diverse team of experienced professionals and young talent in a collaborative environment within the financial services sector


Join NORRIQ to elevate your career, contribute to transformative projects, and make a lasting impact in the financial services industry!

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Are you a versatile AI Engineer who uses technology as a means to solve real business problems? Do you enjoy challenging assumptions, uncovering the true needs behind a client’s request, and developing tailored AI solutions that make a lasting impact? Do you want to strengthen and expand your technical skills under guidance of experienced AI engineers?

At Datashift, we’re looking for an AI Engineer who excels in crafting challenging technical solutions that deliver business value. You’ll work closely with clients to reveal the core challenges before diving into solutions, selecting the best-fit approach—whether it’s generative AI, machine learning, statistical modeling, or something entirely different. You’ll build scalable applications from proof-of-concept to production, always keeping security and privacy top of mind.

Responsibilities 


We see AI as a means, not as a goal. We’re looking for an AI Engineer who always searches for the best technology to address specific data related business problems, whether it’s genAI, machine learning, statistical models, or other methods
Build AI solutions from proof of concept to fully integrated applications, together with other Datashift experts
Translate fuzzy client requirements into creative, pragmatic solutions, delivering rapid proof of concepts to quickly validate ideas and show business value
Scale and harden proven prototypes into robust, production-grade, and secure AI applications
Ensure customer constraints such as security and privacy are met as from the start when developing solutions
Communicate effectively about your technical solution towards different stakeholders at all levels
Work in an agile way and adapt to changing business needs



Qualifications 


At least 2 years of experience in industry, including experience in consultancy (preferred)
Background in business engineering, civil engineering, or related field
Strong Python & SQL skills, with a focus on data cleaning, preprocessing, and building robust pipelines
Knowledge of AI, combining traditional machine learning with modern GenAI solutions (e.g., RAG, agentic workflows)
First experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) to deploy and manage AI solutions.
Affinity with software engineering best practices (clean, modular code, pytest, Git) and DevOps tooling (Docker, CI/CD)
Experience with successful delivery of an AI project in production environment
Excellent communication skills, and proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment
Fluent in English. Fluency in Dutch is a big plus



Interested?

Are you the AI Engineer  we are looking for? Don't hesitate to apply!

Interested?

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Bruxelles
Description:
Description

Vous jouez un rôle central dans la conception, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique avancées, favorisant l’innovation et l’automatisation au sein de l’organisation.

Vous collaborez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour tirer parti des services d’IA dans le cloud, de l’IA générative et d’une infrastructure d’apprentissage automatique évolutive.

Vous veillez à ce que les modèles d’IA soient robustes, éthiques et alignés sur les objectifs commerciaux.

Votre job en deux mots

Principales responsabilités :

Développement de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique :

Déploiement de modèles d’apprentissage automatique et d’apprentissage profond (y compris l’IA générative) pour résoudre des problèmes métier complexes.

Optimisation des modèles en termes de performance, d’évolutivité et de rentabilité dans les environnements cloud Azure.

Mise en œuvre de pipelines MLOps pour automatiser l’entraînement, la validation et le déploiement des modèles.

Infrastructure cloud et d’IA :

Développement et maintenance d’une infrastructure d’IA évolutive sur les plateformes cloud Azure, en utilisant des services tels qu’Azure ML et AKS.

Garantie de déploiements d’IA sécurisés, conformes et hautement disponibles dans le cloud. IA générative et innovation.

Explorer et intégrer des modèles d'IA générative (LLM, etc.) pour des applications telles que : RAG (Real Agile Agile), traitement intelligent de documents, transcription vocale et IA conversationnelle.

Anticiper les tendances en IA (par exemple, le fine-tuning, l'IA multimodale) et proposer des cas d'usage innovants.

Gouvernance des données et des modèles

Garantir la qualité des données, la réduction des biais et le respect des pratiques éthiques en matière d'IA lors du développement des modèles.

Mettre en œuvre des outils de surveillance et d'explicabilité des modèles afin de suivre leurs performances et leur conformité.

Collaboration et mobilisation des parties prenantes

Collaborer avec les équipes produit, les data scientists et les parties prenantes métier pour identifier les opportunités offertes par l'IA.

Traduire les besoins métier en solutions techniques d'IA et communiquer efficacement les résultats obtenus.

Pas besoin d’être un oiseau rare

Mais vous pouvez en devenir un, parmi nous. Chez nous, vous pouvez vous distinguer et révéler le meilleur de vous-même si vous répondez aux critères suivants:


Un master ou un doctorat en sciences, avec d'excellents résultats académiques dans des domaines techniques (économétrie, informatique, intelligence artificielle, etc.).
Une expertise en
techniques d'apprentissage automatique et la volonté de maintenir vos connaissances à jour ; une connaissance approfondie d'algorithmes tels que les forêts
aléatoires, les réseaux de neurones et l'apprentissage par renforcement est indispensable.
GenAI : ingénierie rapide, résultats structurés, etc. (voir les responsabilités).
De solides compétences en programmation Python et SQL.
Une excellente maîtrise du néerlandais ou du français, avec des notions de l'autre langue, et de l'anglais.
Une expérience dans la vulgarisation d'analyses complexes auprès d'un public non technique, grâce à vos talents de conteur et votre capacité à visualiser les données. Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, tant sur le plan technique que commercial.
Une soif d'apprendre, non seulement pour maîtriser de nouveaux algorithmes et technologies, mais aussi sur le plan relationnel ; vous êtes conscient(e) que la valeur de votre travail repose sur la qualité et l'acceptation, et vous souhaitez travailler sur ces deux aspects.
Des compétences exceptionnelles en résolution de problèmes : vous savez qu'une bonne compréhension d'un problème représente au moins 90 % de la solution ; vous faites preuve de créativité et de persévérance pour comprendre les problèmes et trouver des solutions.


Un plus :


Bilinguisme (anglais et néerlandais ou français).
Expérience en développement de produits de données, de la conception à la production.
Compétences en développement full-stack.
Connaissance du cloud, de préférence Azure.



Belfius prend soin de ses talents

Outre la possibilité de faire votre chemin dans un job qui vous plaît, nous vous offrons un contrat à temps plein à durée indéterminée avec :


Un salaire attractif complété par une offre innovante vous octroyant un budget à utiliser selon vos préférences personnelles (p. ex. voiture, vélo, PC, smartphone, tablette, loyer ou crédit hypothécaire sous certaines conditions) et des avantages extralégaux, tels que des chèques-repas, des avantages sur les produits et services internes, une assurance hospitalisation et une assurance groupe.
Des possibilités de développement par le biais d'un large éventail de formations et des opportunités de carrière dans l’ensemble du groupe Belfius.
Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à des horaires flexibles, à la combinaison du travail au bureau et à domicile et un nombre attractif de jours de congé.
Un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Bruxelles, avec une salle de sport branchée, un délicieux restaurant sain et des espaces de réunion confortables, le tout à quelques pas de la rue commerciale, de la gare Bruxelles-Nord et de la station métro Rogier.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
🌍 About the role

We’re looking for an AI Engineer who sits comfortably at the intersection of data science, machine learning, and Generative AI.

You’ll work on real-world AI solutions, from classical ML models to LLM-powered applications, and take them all the way from idea to production. This is not a research-only role, and not a pure software role either: it’s about applied AI that delivers business impact.

You’ll collaborate closely with data, engineering, and business stakeholders, and help shape how AI is used responsibly and effectively.




🧠 What you’ll do

Design, build, and evaluate machine learning models (classification, regression, forecasting, NLP, etc.)
Develop Generative AI solutions (LLMs, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, agents)
Translate business problems into AI use cases with measurable impact
Prepare, explore, and model data using strong data science foundations
Build production-ready AI systems (APIs, pipelines, monitoring, retraining)
Work with cloud and MLOps tooling to deploy and maintain models
Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Stay up to date with evolving AI and GenAI best practices




🛠️ What you bring

Strong foundation in data science & machine learning
Hands-on experience with Python and ML libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow)
Experience with or strong interest in Generative AI / LLMs (e.g. RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering)
Solid software engineering mindset (clean code, version control, testing)
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and deployment patterns
Comfort working across the full AI lifecycle: data → model → production
Curious, pragmatic, and impact-driven mindset




⭐ Nice to have

Experience with MLOps (CI/CD, MLflow, feature stores, monitoring)
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex)
Experience in regulated or enterprise environments
Consulting or client-facing experience




🎯 Why join us

Work on real AI solutions, not demos or slideware
High ownership and autonomy
Exposure to both classical ML and cutting-edge GenAI
Strong focus on quality, responsibility, and long-term impact
Opportunity to grow into technical lead or solution architect roles

Title: Consultant in Data Science
Description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.





Job Description



As a consultant in Data Science, you will be involved in transformation projects at our clients. You will execute project assignments in modelling and digital transformation (business/IT analysis and partial coding) environments with a good deal of business perspectives:



Machine learning, AI and statistics: developing predictive models of decision making (supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, econometrics, forecasting, quantitative diagnosis,...)
Operational research : assistance in the design and implementation of constraint optimization solutions and simulation models
Big Data : Algorithmic knowledge for large and unstructured data processing

You will get the opportunity to actively contribute to Sia’s internal activities:



Development and reinforcement of our offer, by understanding and interpreting data science innovation and challenges
Business development, by contributing to need definition and participating in our commercial initiatives

Equipped with the entrepreneurial fibre, you are ready to cooperate in a fast growing company.







In return, you can expect:



An international company that gives importance to diversity, inclusion, employee well-being and corporate social responsibilities actions.
A great working atmosphere with friendly and professional colleagues where innovation and entrepreneurship are encouraged
A personal development plan with a regular follow-up as well training opportunities to develop yourself
A competitive salary with great advantages, like mobility budget, hospital insurance, performance -related bonus,...


Qualifications


University Master Civil Engineer (applied mathematics, IT or similar)
0 to 3 years’ experience as a consultant
Outstanding team player with great interpersonal and communication skills
Strong interest in data science and related sectors such as Energy and Finance
You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
Analytical mind, exploring options and able to synthesize into conclusions
Dynamic, result oriented, rigorous and committed
Trilingual: French, Dutch and English
Prepared to participate in temporary assignments abroad


Additional Information



We are unable to provide a work permit for this position



Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Professional

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson is seeking a Data Science & AI Automation Lead to join Healthcare Compliance (HCC) Global Operations as a senior individual contributor and technical expert located in Singapore; Beerse, Belgium; High Wycombe, United Kingdom; or New Brunswick, New Jersey, USA.

In this hands-on role, you will design and deliver AI-powered automation, advanced analytics, digital monitoring, and Copilot-enabled solutions that enhance compliance operations globally. Partnering closely with compliance, business, and technology teams, you will translate complex challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions that improve risk management, decision-making, operational efficiency, and user experience across multiple regions and markets.

Position Summary

The Data Science & AI Automation Lead is responsible for developing and scaling innovative analytics, automation, and AI solutions that strengthen Healthcare Compliance operations worldwide.

Acting as a technical lead, this role drives the adoption of advanced analytics, generative AI, Copilot agents, intelligent monitoring platforms, and Power Platform solutions to deliver actionable insights, streamline processes, and enable data-driven decision-making across HCC functions.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Copilot Solutions


Lead design and implementation of Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, and Generative AI solutions supporting Healthcare Compliance operations.
Develop and deploy Copilot Agents, policy assistants, chatbot solutions, and knowledge retrieval capabilities to improve user experience and productivity.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate business opportunities into scalable enterprise solutions.

Title: VIE – Data Scientist & Data Analyst (H/F) – Belgique
Description:
Contexte et environnement

Au sein de TotalEnergies Charging Solutions Belgium (TCSB), filiale de la branche Marketing & Services de TotalEnergies, l'entité Data intervient sur les activités d'analyse de données, de data science et de transformation des plateformes de données pour les activités de recharge de véhicules électriques.

L'équipe Data accompagne les besoins métiers de la filiale depuis l'identification des cas d'usage jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de solutions analytiques et prédictives, en passant par la collecte, l'exploitation et la valorisation des données.

Vérifiez votre éligibilité au programme ainsi que les spécificités pays sur le site internet : https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/qu-est-ce-que-le-volontariat-international

Merci de candidater en anglais.

Activités

Vos principales missions :

Développement de modèles prédictifs et de solutions Data Science


Participer à la création de modèles prédictifs appliqués aux activités de recharge pour véhicules électriques.
Exploiter et analyser des données afin d'optimiser l'implantation des bornes de recharge, les coûts d'installation et les opérations de maintenance.
Exploiter et analyser des volumes importants de données internes et externes.
Développer de nouvelles solutions Data Science.



Migration et transformation des plateformes de données


Accompagner les projets de migration de plateformes et de transformation des environnements de données.
Développer et adapter des traitements, dashboards, modèles analytiques et solutions de reporting pour les équipes métier.
Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de l'architecture data locale et à la structuration des flux de données.
Développer des modèles analytiques, des outils de visualisation et des solutions de reporting à destination des équipes métiers.
Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles belges ainsi qu'avec les équipes Data et Digital du siège afin de répondre aux besoins métiers et d'accompagner les évolutions des outils.



Le poste combine des activités Data Analysis (50%) et Data Scientist Analysis (50%), centré sur l'analyse de données, la modélisation prédictive et la transformation des plateformes data dans le domaine de la mobilité électrique.

Profil du candidat

Diplômé d'un Bac+5 minimum en Data Science, Data Engineering, (école de commerce ou université.)

Vous bénéficiez d'une première expérience en Data Science, Data Analytics.

La connaissance du secteur de l'énergie constitue un atout.

Vous disposez de compétences en :


Databricks ;
Snowflake ;
Clustering ;
Segmentation ;
Scoring ;



Vous maîtrisez les outils suivants :


Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn) ;
SQL ;
Modèles de Machine Learning (Modélisation prédictive).



Un niveau d'anglais B2/C1 est requis. Un niveau de français C1 minimum est également demandé. La connaissance du néerlandais constitue un atout.

Informations supplémentaires

Date de début : Q4 2026

TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats.

Title: AI & Data Engineer
Description:
What You'll Do

Are you the AI & Data Engineer who wants to join our team to develop innovative data pipelines and state-of-the-art AI solutions?

As an AI & Data Engineer at iO, you are first and foremost an experienced software engineer who builds, integrates, and operationalizes AI and data solutions within clients’ existing IT ecosystems.

You will work on a wide variety of AI challenges: from intelligently leveraging or fine-tuning Large Language Models, agent and multi-agent setups, and applying RAG patterns, to building ETL pipelines that feed a data platform. A recurring pattern in your work is integrating existing cloud services and APIs into an efficient, scalable, and reliable solution. The focus lies on building production-grade systems that function correctly within complex, often enterprise-level IT landscapes.

Prompt engineering is an art form to you. You think creatively about how to achieve the best results, while paying attention to preventing hallucinations and implementing smart guardrails. You evaluate your solutions systematically to gain insight into output quality.

In your work, you will encounter many forms of AI: from statistical models to Large Language Models, from Generative AI in the domains of image, video, and audio to Natural Language Processing. The emphasis is mainly on applying and integrating existing models and services, and building the infrastructure around them.

You will work on a wide range of client challenges: from automatically analyzing documents to detecting events in audio or video data, building agents and orchestration solutions, generating graphical output based on data, or creating and validating content. Wherever AI can add value, you design and implement the complete solution as an engineer.

You collaborate with various AI experts within iO and with technical teams on the client side. Your solutions are based on modern (cloud) platforms, SaaS services, and programming languages such as TypeScript and Python.

What Are Your Responsibilities as an AI & Data Engineer?


Designing AI & Data solutions: Analyze client challenges related to AI and data and define solutions, approaches, and architecture
Software engineering & integration: Develop backend components, APIs, and services to ensure AI solutions integrate seamlessly with existing applications and platforms
Data Pipeline Development: Design and build robust ETL/ELT processes and real-time data streams
Data Platform Architecture: Set up modern data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics platforms
AI Integration: Implement machine learning pipelines and integrate AI services into data workflows
Data Quality & Governance: Ensure data quality, security, and compliance within data ecosystems
Performance Optimization: Optimize data processing performance and scalability
Cloud Data Services: Work with cloud-native data services such as AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, or Google Dataflow
Monitoring & Observability: Implement monitoring and alerting for data pipelines and AI workloads


Your Qualities And Skills As AI & Data Engineer


You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with a focus on software engineering
You have several years of experience as a software engineer and have worked on data- and/or AI-driven systems in a professional, preferably enterprise, environment
You have experience with different LLM architectures and understand the strengths and weaknesses of various AI solutions
You are familiar with the principles of modern data architectures, data modeling, and big data processing
You are proficient in modern data processing languages such as Python and SQL, and have experience with frameworks such as Apache Spark, Pandas, or Dask
You are familiar with AWS or Azure cloud data platforms
You have a strong foundation in software engineering, including knowledge of CI/CD, unit testing, Git (flow), secure development, error handling, asynchronous operations, and real-time data streams
You are able to translate your ideas into technical architecture diagrams, data flow schemas, and documentation, while also clearly explaining your solutions to less technical stakeholders (clients and colleagues)
You enjoy sparring with colleagues about ideas and solutions and working collaboratively to achieve better results


What’s in it for you

Vacation icon Vacation icon used in website

32 vacation days

Based on a 40-hour work week, you’ll have 20 vacation days and 12 compensatory days of leave (reduction of working time).

Money icon Money icon used in website

Mobility & end-of-year bonus

After working at iO for 6 months, you can count on an end-of-year bonus. And in terms of mobility, you can choose from various options, depending on your job or preference.

SafeEnvironment icon Safe Environment icon used in website

Hospitalisation insurance

When something unfortunate happens, the last thing you need is the added stress of unexpected costs. That’s why all employees get hospitalisation insurance at Axa.

HybridWorking icon Hybrid Working icon used in website

Hybrid working

A good work-life balance is super important. Together with your team, you’ll decide when and where you work.

FoodBenefits icon Food Benefits icon used in website

Healthy snacks & lunch

At every iO campus, you can grab a healthy snack throughout the day and have a healthy and varied lunch for a small fee.

TrainingBudget icon Training Budget icon used in website

Personal training budget

Each year, you’ll get a budget of €3,000 to develop yourself, in your profession or as a person, through training, events, or courses.

Celebrations icon Celebrations icon used in website

Celebrating together

If there’s something to celebrate, we know how to party! From time to time, the party team at your campus will organise the best (theme) parties.

Title: Data Scientist - GenAI
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Shape the Future of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)

Are you an early-career professional excited to harness the power of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)? Artefact Belgium is seeking a Data Scientist - Gen AI to join our innovative team in Brussels. Our Belgian team specializes in LLM and GenAI projects, and this is your chance to work on cutting-edge solutions, collaborate with top-tier experts, and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic, forward-thinking environment.

Who You Are

A recent graduate or professional with 1 to 3 years of experience, with hands-on experience working with LLMs and a passion for generative AI and NLP. Motivated to apply your technical expertise to real-world challenges in AI. Able to thrive in collaborative settings while independently driving your own workstreams. Eager to learn, grow, and push the boundaries of what's possible in AI innovation.

Who We Are

Artefact is a leading Data & AI consulting firm operating at the forefront of AI innovation. With a global presence, we help clients across industries—public health, manufacturing, etc. —leverage generative AI to achieve transformative outcomes. Our team in Belgium is specialized in LLM and GenAI projects, working on the most advanced applications of these technologies. At Artefact, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, with a strong commitment to inclusivity and employee growth.

What You Will Do


Collaborate with the team to design, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art models for client projects and internal tools.
Develop and integrate agentic AI solutions using tool calling, and emerging protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create autonomous, context-aware applications.
Research and implement innovative generative AI applications to solve complex business problems.
Design and implement comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance, establishing quality metrics and benchmarks that guide development decisions and ensure reliable, production-ready solutions.
Optimize the performance, scalability, and usability of LLM-powered products and tools.
Contribute to the deployment and maintenance of AI systems, including models, APIs, and supporting infrastructure.
Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions to shape impactful solutions.


What You Bring


A degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related field.
Experience working with LLMs, generative AI, or advanced NLP applications (e.g., fine-tuning models, using frameworks like Hugging Face or OpenAI).
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI and NLP libraries.
Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with an ability to address real-world challenges through AI.
Good communication skills in English, Dutch or French; additional languages are a plus.
A growth mindset, adaptability, and eagerness to work in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment.


What We Offer


A competitive salary with benefits tailored for early-career professionals.
Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art LLM technologies in impactful projects.
A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters creativity and professional development.
Resources for ongoing training, certification, and skill-building in generative AI and related fields.
A collaborative, inclusive workplace with access to global expertise through Artefact's network.


This position is based in Brussels.

Don't worry if you don't meet every criterion! We value passion, potential, and a commitment to innovation. If you're excited about generative AI and ready to grow your career, we'd love to hear from you!

  • Collaborate with the team to design, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art models for client projects and internal tools.
  • Develop and integrate agentic AI solutions using tool calling, and emerging protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create autonomous, context-aware applications.
  • Research and implement innovative generative AI applications to solve complex business problems.
  • Design and implement comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance, establishing quality metrics and benchmarks that guide development decisions and ensure reliable, production-ready solutions.
  • Optimize the performance, scalability, and usability of LLM-powered products and tools.
  • Contribute to the deployment and maintenance of AI systems, including models, APIs, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions to shape impactful solutions.

What You Bring

  • A degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related field.
  • Experience working with LLMs, generative AI, or advanced NLP applications (e.g., fine-tuning models, using frameworks like Hugging Face or OpenAI).
  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI and NLP libraries.
  • Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with an ability to address real-world challenges through AI.
  • Good communication skills in English, Dutch or French; additional languages are a plus.
  • A growth mindset, adaptability, and eagerness to work in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary with benefits tailored for early-career professionals.
  • Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art LLM technologies in impactful projects.
  • A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters creativity and professional development.
  • Resources for ongoing training, certification, and skill-building in generative AI and related fields.
  • A collaborative, inclusive workplace with access to global expertise through Artefact's network.

This position is based in Brussels.

Don't worry if you don't meet every criterion! We value passion, potential, and a commitment to innovation. If you're excited about generative AI and ready to grow your career, we'd love to hear from you!

Title: Data Scientist – Business Analyst

The data lab offers expertise and innovative solutions regarding data science and analytics. Indicate which data is needed when collecting data to perform analyses, both in terms of data availability, quality, format, granularity, etc.
Selecting and creating quality machine learning models, extracting insights from data and models, and visualizing these results.

Title: Data & Simulation Specialist
Description:
Cartamundi is wereldmarktleider in “play”-oplossingen. Denk aan speelkaarten, kaart- en bordspellen, collectibles en trading card games.

Ons doel? “Live Different, Play Different” voor iedereen. Met bijna 3.000 mensen zetten we ons elke dag in om die ambitie waar te maken. Ons familiebedrijf, met hoofdkantoor in België, heeft daarvoor een wereldwijd netwerk van designcenters, verkoopkantoren en productiefaciliteiten. Een netwerk dat loopt van de VS en Brazilië tot Europa en Japan.

Cartamundi heeft een wereldwijde merkenportefeuille met heritage brands zoals Bicycle®, Bee®, Copag®, Shuffle® en heel wat lokaal geliefde merken. We zijn ook de vertrouwde partner van toonaangevende speelgoed- en entertainmentbedrijven voor productie- en distributieoplossingen.

De drukpersen van Cartamundi draaien al sinds 1765. We koppelen die rijke traditie aan innovatie in digitale en hybride speelervaringen. Om zo relevant te blijven – vandaag en morgen.

Cartamundi voert een strategie van duurzame en winstgevende groei. Op die manier streven we ernaar om onze planeet en ons bedrijf in topconditie te houden voor de komende generaties.




Lees meer op www.cartamundi.com

Volg ons op LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/cartamundi




Data & Simulation Analyst

Als Data & Simulation Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van complexe en unieke klantbehoeften naar correcte, efficiënte en productieklare collatieschema’s voor collectible kaartenproducten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat alle kaartvarianten in de juiste aantallen, samenstellingen en configuraties in flowpacks, decks en displays terechtkomen, in lijn met zowel klantverwachtingen als productietechnische mogelijkheden.




Jouw functie

Met jouw analytische blik en technische feeling…




…Vertaal je klantbehoeften naar haalbare oplossingen

Je analyseert klantwensen en adviseert op basis van technische en statistische inzichten.




…Ontwerp je collatieschema’s van A tot Z

Je ontwikkelt vorm-, lay‑out- en dropschema’s en zorgt voor correcte kaartcombinaties.
Je maakt scenario­berekeningen voor duidelijke keuzes en alternatieven.




…Lever je sterke simulaties en analyses

Je bouwt displaysimulaties op basis van kansberekening.
Je maakt impactanalyses en rapporten die beslissingen ondersteunen.




…Bewaak je data en kwaliteit

Je houdt namelists en control sheets up-to-date.
Je voert nauwkeurige 4‑eyes checks uit.




…Optimaliseer je tools en processen

Je verbetert bestaande tools en workflows en ondersteunt toolontwikkeling.




…Communiceer je vlot met interne partners

Je stemt af met Sales en productie en maakt technische info begrijpelijk voor iedereen.




Jouw profiel

Je bent voor ons de ideale kandidaat omdat je…

Denkt op masterniveau en een wetenschappelijke of wiskundige achtergrond hebt.
Sterke analytische skills hebt en vaardig bent in statistische berekeningen.
Nauwkeurig werkt, een oog hebt voor detail en steeds gaat voor topkwaliteit (4 eyes mindset zit in jouw DNA).
Complexe materie helder kan uitleggen en graag meedenkt in oplossingen.
Uitblinkt in Excel. Basis tot programmeervaardigheden is mooi meegenomen.
De taal van zowel Sales als Productie begrijpt en deze werelden moeiteloos met elkaar verbindt.
Proactief verbeterkansen ziet en graag werkt aan efficiëntere processen en slimmere tools.
Je jezelf vlot kan uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.




Aanbod

We bieden je de uitdaging om zelfstandig een boeiende en gevarieerde job uit te oefenen. Je komt terecht in een dynamische onderneming en een hecht team waar je kan werken in een aangename werksfeer. Je krijgt de mogelijkheden jezelf te ontwikkelen. Het salarispakket is in overeenstemming met je ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie.




Interesse?

Toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging? Surf naar www.cartamundi.com/nl/careers en solliciteer online.
