Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Company Description

Sopra Steria offers tailored, end-to-end corporate technology and software solutions to help clients make bold choices and deliver results. Successfully so! With more than 56.000 colleagues in 30 countries, we rank as Europe’s leading digital solutions provider. Some of the most successful companies in Europe rely on our technology due to our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and value in business development.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together!

Job Description

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You are fully convinced that data science isn’t a hype, but you also believe that, in order to be valuable and really make a company smarter, it must be done right. Your goal is therefore to create the most impactful solution possible in the quickest and easiest way possible so that real value can be extracted from data and artificial intelligence. 

Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who has:


A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related field.
Min. 2 years of hands-on experience developing and implementing AI/ML models in production environments.
Strong Python programming skills, including experience with API-building frameworks such as FastAPI and prototyping tools like Streamlit.
Experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar is considered a strong asset.
Solid understanding of machine learning including model evaluation techniques and familiarity with advanced applications such as: NLP, forecasting, optimization, computer vision.
Experience in working with cloud-based environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and ML pipelines is a strong asset.
Experience with Generative AI technologies, prompt engineering, and large language models, is a strong asset.
Hands-on knowledge of vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Azure AI Search) for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines is a strong asset.
Strong communication and business analysis skills and genuinely interested in understanding the customer’s business context and challenges.
You can explain complex technical concepts in simple, accessible language to non-technical stakeholders.
A collaborative, open-minded mindset and a drive to keep learning in a fast-evolving field.
You're fluent in Dutch or French, as well as English.


What we can offer:


A dynamic role within OptimAI, a leading AI competence center focused on applied, impactful AI.
The opportunity to work on real-world projects across sectors, from logistics and government to healthcare and finance.
Access to expert colleagues, mentorship, and tailored learning opportunities to accelerate your growth.
A flexible hybrid work model and a strong focus on work-life balance.
A culture of innovation, inclusion, and continuous improvement where your ideas and input are valued.


Additional Information

Our employees are known for making bold choices and delivering results. Work among high-level professionals at the forefront of corporate software solutions and innovation at Europe’s Leading Digital Service Provider.  

We offer a generous employee benefits package that includes:


A company car or mobility budget
Laptop, phone & phone subscription
A competitive salary and indefinite contract
Insurance coverage, meal vouchers, eco-cheques, and more
Continuous learning opportunities through the Sopra Steria Academy to support your career development


People are the cornerstone of our success. That’s why we aspire to be bolder together. Our goal is to build high-functioning teams and healthy team environments that inspire and help each other to deliver excellence for each of our customers.  

Excited about this job opportunity? Ready to shape the world with us? Great! We are looking forward to your application! 

At OptimAI, we combine the best of both worlds: data science and supply chain optimization. You will be part of a forward-thinking team where you can shape the future of data science and supply chain management. This is an excellent opportunity to make a real difference and grow your career in a field that is rapidly evolving and in high demand.

If you thrive on challenge, continuous learning, and want to make an impact in a fast-growing field, apply now to join the OptimAI Team.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, ancestry, nationality, color, family or medical leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Title: Data Scientist Total Video
Description:
Amsterdam - Combine Data Science, AI, and Media to transform the advertising market. At DPG Media, our work touches over 90% of Dutch households daily. As a Data Scientist Total Video, you will take the lead in integrating TV advertising and digital video advertising into a scalable Total Video advertising product. If you are looking for a high-impact role where you can build an innovative data product from the ground up, this is your call.

What will you do?

As a Data Scientist Total Video, you develop data products at the intersection of data science, machine learning engineering, and AI to enable Total Video at scale. You provide the crucial holistic data focus needed to successfully integrate the worlds of TV advertising and online video advertising. With your expertise, you translate complex business challenges into concrete data solutions and contribute directly to the further development of an innovative product, that will transform the advertising market. You do this by:


Analyzing complex datasets and translating stakeholder challenges into concrete solutions, that you continuously improve iteratively
Developing and implementing scalable data products and models within a production environment
Collaborating within a dedicated development and product team on the realization of Total Video for the Belgian and Dutch markets
Working closely with Ad Alliance in the Netherlands and DPG Media Advertising in Belgium


Who are we?

We are the Total Video team, part of the Advertising Ecosystem & Strategy domain. In the coming years, we are investing heavily in the development of Total Video: a unique opportunity to help build a product from the ground up that will change the advertising market. The team is currently being built and consists of professionals with diverse backgrounds in business, data, product, and technology.

What makes you the ideal candidate?

For this role, we are looking for a person that is able to create and build things from scratch. Is optimistic, committed, driven, and creative. In addition, you bring:


5+ years experience in a similar role
Deep expertise in data science and machine learning, enabling you to design, train, and implement models in production environments
Experience transforming data models into scalable data products, preferably within a media or advertising environment
Strong analytical and conceptual skills, allowing you to recognize patterns in complex datasets and translate them into concrete solutions
Experience with machine learning tools and MLOps systems such as Docker, Databricks, and MLflow
Strong communication skills to clearly convey insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we encourage you to apply for this role. It is precisely the differences between colleagues that lead to surprising insights and innovative solutions. And that fits perfectly with who we are as an organization. We are curious to learn more about you and the qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment? Click here!

What do we offer?

You will join an inspiring work environment that is constantly evolving. You will work with colleagues who think in possibilities, see opportunities, and encourage you to continue developing yourself every day. We support this through our DPG Academy, giving you every opportunity to get the best out of yourself and grow as a true media maker.

💰 A salary that matches your experience

📝 A 36-hour working week

💰 8% holiday allowance and a 4% personal choice budget

💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media’s performance

🎓 Plenty of opportunities for development, both on the job and online through our DPG Academy

🎉 Flexibility to align your own cultural holidays

🏢 A fantastic new office in Amsterdam (Mediavaert). From spontaneous drinks to team outings and our legendary staff party, you will quickly feel at home here!

Even more reasons to join DPG Media

At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 strong news brands, magazines, television programs, radio stations, and online services such as Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM, and more. Every month, we reach over 90% of the Dutch population and 8 out of 10 Flemish people. We offer a professional work environment where freedom and ownership are highly valued. You will have every opportunity to work on your future through workshops and training programs. Feel free to be an entrepreneur, a learner, a team player, and above all, yourself. Everyone is welcome at DPG Media, regardless of background. More than 5,500 talented colleagues are ready to welcome you into a team, whether it is a project team, a pub quiz team, or a sports team.

Discover what we have to offer you. And while you are at it, you can also find us on Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

Applying, and then?

Ready to get started? Apply directly no later than January 12. You will receive a response to your application within 10 working days. Interviews will take place between January 13 and January 23, and final decisions will be communicated by January 31. If you are selected for the first round, we will contact you by phone to schedule an interview at our Amsterdam office.

As a Data Scientist Total Video, you will take the lead in integrating TV advertising and digital video advertising into a scalable Total Video advertising product. If you are looking for a high-impact role where you can build an innovative data product from the ground up, this is your call.

What will you do?

As a Data Scientist Total Video, you develop data products at the intersection of data science, machine learning engineering, and AI to enable Total Video at scale. You provide the crucial holistic data focus needed to successfully integrate the worlds of TV advertising and online video advertising. With your expertise, you translate complex business challenges into concrete data solutions and contribute directly to the further development of an innovative product, that will transform the advertising market. You do this by:

  • Analyzing complex datasets and translating stakeholder challenges into concrete solutions, that you continuously improve iteratively
  • Developing and implementing scalable data products and models within a production environment
  • Collaborating within a dedicated development and product team on the realization of Total Video for the Belgian and Dutch markets
  • Working closely with Ad Alliance in the Netherlands and DPG Media Advertising in Belgium

Who are we?

We are the Total Video team, part of the Advertising Ecosystem & Strategy domain. In the coming years, we are investing heavily in the development of Total Video: a unique opportunity to help build a product from the ground up that will change the advertising market. The team is currently being built and consists of professionals with diverse backgrounds in business, data, product, and technology.

What makes you the ideal candidate?

For this role, we are looking for a person that is able to create and build things from scratch. Is optimistic, committed, driven, and creative. In addition, you bring:

  • 5+ years experience in a similar role
  • Deep expertise in data science and machine learning, enabling you to design, train, and implement models in production environments
  • Experience transforming data models into scalable data products, preferably within a media or advertising environment
  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, allowing you to recognize patterns in complex datasets and translate them into concrete solutions
  • Experience with machine learning tools and MLOps systems such as Docker, Databricks, and MLflow
  • Strong communication skills to clearly convey insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we encourage you to apply for this role. It is precisely the differences between colleagues that lead to surprising insights and innovative solutions. And that fits perfectly with who we are as an organization. We are curious to learn more about you and the qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment? Click here!

What do we offer?

You will join an inspiring work environment that is constantly evolving. You will work with colleagues who think in possibilities, see opportunities, and encourage you to continue developing yourself every day. We support this through our DPG Academy, giving you every opportunity to get the best out of yourself and grow as a true media maker.

💰 A salary that matches your experience

📝 A 36-hour working week

💰 8% holiday allowance and a 4% personal choice budget

💰 Annual profit sharing based on DPG Media’s performance

🎓 Plenty of opportunities for development, both on the job and online through our DPG Academy

🎉 Flexibility to align your own cultural holidays

🏢 A fantastic new office in Amsterdam (Mediavaert). From spontaneous drinks to team outings and our legendary staff party, you will quickly feel at home here!

Even more reasons to join DPG Media

At DPG Media, we work for more than 90 strong news brands, magazines, television programs, radio stations, and online services such as Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM, and more. Every month, we reach over 90% of the Dutch population and 8 out of 10 Flemish people. We offer a professional work environment where freedom and ownership are highly valued. You will have every opportunity to work on your future through workshops and training programs. Feel free to be an entrepreneur, a learner, a team player, and above all, yourself. Everyone is welcome at DPG Media, regardless of background. More than 5,500 talented colleagues are ready to welcome you into a team, whether it is a project team, a pub quiz team, or a sports team.

Discover what we have to offer you. And while you are at it, you can also find us on Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

Applying, and then?

Ready to get started? Apply directly no later than January 12. You will receive a response to your application within 10 working days. Interviews will take place between January 13 and January 23, and final decisions will be communicated by January 31. If you are selected for the first round, we will contact you by phone to schedule an interview at our Amsterdam office.

Title: Freelance Data Scientist with Ontology and Graph expertise
Description:
Job Description

adesso Belgium is looking for a data scientist (2) to support our customer in building an AI Agent Platform Data Foundations.

Customer Info

Our customer is an international, independent provider of indirect procurement services.

Job Requirements

Preferred start date: 1xASAP and 1x January 2027

Duration: 12 months

Rate: depending on your location

Time Zone: CET

Your role

Build the data and context layer that powers the customer's procurement AI agent platform — canonical models, knowledge graph, semantic/taxonomy layer, and the retrieval and evaluation pipelines agents depend on. This is production infrastructure from day one, not a proof of concept: versioned, tested, and built for multiple tenants.

You Will Work On


Data products & canonical modeling — Design and deliver the first reference data products (Supplier Master, Spend Cube, Contract Register) end to end, from source ingestion through the canonical model.
Knowledge graph & ontology — Stand up and operate the platform and working graphs (ontology, reference data, tenant separation); own the graph-plus-vector retrieval design, deciding per source whether data is represented as entities/relationships, embeddings, or both.
Master data & semantic layer — Build matching rules, golden records, and stewardship processes for Suppliers, Contracts, and Categories; contribute to the business glossary and taxonomy-to-ontology mapping.
Extraction & evaluation — Build document-extraction pipelines (e.g., from SharePoint sources) with confidence scoring and human review for uncertain cases; build and maintain labelled evaluation datasets and accuracy benchmarks against agreed thresholds.
Connector framework — Build source connectors (starting with Fabric data products and master data golden records) so new sources can be onboarded without modifying the graph core or query service.
Quality feedback loop — Implement the mechanism routing agent overrides, failures, or low-confidence retrievals back to data owners so data products improve over time rather than decay.
Engineering practice — Work exclusively in the GitHub/Azure environment; ship via pull request with CI (build, tests, security scan, evaluation fixtures); version all schemas, connector contracts, and extraction configs.


Hard Skills

Required Experience


Demonstrated experience taking a knowledge graph system to production (not just prototyping) — schema design, query performance, tenant/data isolation - Using Neo4J and Python
Strong background in semantic modeling: ontologies, taxonomies, business glossaries, and their relationship to graph and canonical data models.
Hands-on experience with semantic web standards and technologies including OWL/OWL2, RDF, RDFS, SPARQL, ontology lifecycle management, taxonomy alignment, and semantic reasoning.
Experience building data products and master-data pipelines (entity matching, golden-record consolidation, stewardship workflows).
Experience designing and implementing hybrid retrieval architectures combining graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and vector databases to support semantic search, RAG, and AI agent workloads.
Experience with retrieval architectures combining graph and vector/embedding approaches.
Experience building and maintaining labelled evaluation datasets and measuring extraction/model accuracy against a threshold.
Proficiency with modern data/ML engineering practices: version control, CI/CD, automated testing, containerized deployment
Experience with Microsoft Fabric and SharePoint-based document extraction pipelines.


Soft Skills


Fluent in ENG
Open to travelling if needed (EU), this position is fully remote
Collaborative mindset, ideally with a proven similar work experience


Why join adesso Belgium?


Work in an international group with strong local expertise in Belgium.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver trusted, compliant, reusable data products.
Flexible freelance setup with the support of a growing adesso Belgium community.

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
Don’t settle for just any consulting company, choose the one that’s right for you!




At Data Wizards, we value perseverance, curiosity, creativity, integrity and excellence. In that sense, we are looking for passionate AI & data professionals who want to help companies navigate the transition the world is facing today, and who want to be part of the Wizard adventure we are building.




On our side, we do our best to find exciting, challenging and meaningful projects for you. Today, we work with companies of all sizes, across various sectors, where we believe our work brings real value and purpose.




We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. So this job description is for anyone in data out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄




We’re on the lookout for an AI Engineer to join our team of Wizards!




As an AI Engineer, your mission would include:




Collaborating with clients to define business and technical requirements for AI and data-driven solutions.
Designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models and AI solutions tailored to various industries.
Working with stakeholders to identify and implement AI strategies that drive business value.
Ensuring models are production-ready, scalable, and adhere to best DevOps/MLOps practices.
Leveraging cloud environments, particularly Azure, to optimize data processing and AI model performance.
Engaging with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, AI engineers, and consultants, to deliver high-quality AI solutions.
Supporting the continuous improvement of AI methodologies and contributing to internal innovations within the company.
Mentoring junior team members and sharing knowledge across the organization.
Attending client meetings and presenting findings, recommendations, and AI solutions in a clear and structured manner.




Job requirements




You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:




Background




A bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field (such as business or engineering).
3-4 years of experience in a consulting environment or a related AI/ML engineering role.
Experience working at the intersection of consulting, machine learning engineering, and data science.




Technical Skills




Strong expertise in Python and SQL.
In-depth knowledge of machine learning, AI, and statistical techniques.
Hands-on experience with NLP is a significant plus.
Proficiency in cloud environments, particularly Azure.
Familiarity with popular machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Experience deploying AI/ML models into production and working with LLMs in a real-world setting.
Knowledge of best practices in DevOps/MLOps.




Soft Skills




Strong client-facing skills with the ability to translate business problems into AI-driven solutions.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.
A problem-solving mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous learning.




Practical Info




Languages: Fluent in English. French or Dutch Native.




We know that finding the right job isn’t just about the role, it’s about what’s in it for you, too. While we’re a start-up, we’re big on taking care of our people right from day one.




Here’s a sneak peek at what we offer:




💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated

Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with a fuel card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers
Opportunity to earn company stock over time




🎯 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive

Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model
Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces with a 24/7 open gym fully equiped
A Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles 🎮
A massage chair for those deep-thinking moments 🧘
Fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕




✨ And most importantly, a growing company where opportunities are limitless!




Our Recruitment Process:

Quick intro call with our HR team
HR Interview
Technical Interview
Partner Meet-up
Potential Interview with client




About us

At Data Wizards, we value perseverance, curiosity, creativity, integrity and excellence. In that sense, we are looking for passionate AI & data professionals who want to help companies navigate the transition the world is facing today, and who want to be part of the Wizard adventure we are building.




On our side, we do our best to find exciting, challenging and meaningful projects for you. Today, we work with companies of all sizes, across various sectors, where we believe our work brings real value and purpose.




If you’re passionate about what we do but aren’t sure you meet every single requirement, don’t hesitate to apply. We value potential, mindset, and growth as much as experience. At Data Wizards, we believe diversity is our strength. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences because different viewpoints help us grow and evolve.




Let’s build the future of AI & Data, together🤝

The consultancy world moves fast, and while we always aim to match great talent with the right opportunity, there might not always be an immediate fit. With your permission, we’ll gladly keep your profile in mind for future missions and hope to collaborate with you soon on an exciting project at Data Wizards!

Title: AI/ML Engineer
Description:
What we are building at Sitemark




Sitemark is the AI and robotics platform for building and operating renewable energy. The world's leading Owners, EPCs, and O&M companies use Sitemark.




What problem are we solving and why is this important to solve




The world is building one of the largest infrastructure shifts in history — and it needs better tools to get it done. Renewable energy projects are growing in scale, complexity, and urgency, but the teams responsible for building and operating them are stretched thin — buried in repetitive work, disconnected systems, and running out of time. That's why we built Sitemark: AI and robotics take the repetitive load off these teams, from the field to the office, so their time goes to what matters — and sites get built faster and perform better.




The team you'll join




You will join an extremely talented team of incredibly passionate, high-energy people. We go the extra mile while having the best time of our lives.




How we operate





We care deeply about our customers and the problems we solve for them.


We move fast, keep things simple, and focus on what matters.


We keep our quality bar high by staying lean and hiring only the best.



Tasks


At Sitemark, AI sits at the heart of the product. Drones and robots capture vast amounts of imagery from renewable energy sites, and our computer-vision models turn it into the answers customers act on. We need someone to scale that capability so it ships reliably and moves real business metrics.




As our AI/ML Engineer, you own the AI/ML side of the platform: training and improving the computer-vision models behind our products, and making sure they actually ship and perform in production. You'll raise our throughput across model implementation, training runs, and dataset iteration — directly unblocking the team and our customers.




We're looking for a pragmatic engineer-scientist, not a paper-chaser. Models exist to solve real problems: if an off-the-shelf model fine-tuned on our data does the job, that's a great answer. We care about results in the product, not novelty in a paper. No solar or energy background required — we'll teach you the domain; curiosity matters more.




You'll report to the Head of Product & Engineering, with coaching and technical sparring from the Engineering Lead, and work in cross-functional squads alongside platform engineers, the product team, and — closely — our operations teams and customers.




What you'll do





Train, fine-tune, and ship computer-vision models for tasks like thermal anomaly detection and classification, defect detection on high-resolution imagery, object detection on drone imagery, and stitching/co-registration support.


Level up the MLOps backbone that lets us ship reliably: experiment tracking, reproducible training, dataset versioning, a model registry, deployment pipelines, production monitoring, and a feedback loop from labeled operations data back into training. This is where AI meets engineering, and it's a big part of what makes the role impactful.


Run the full experimental loop end to end: curate and improve datasets, design training runs, analyse errors, and iterate.


Take on the harder architectural problems when they matter — for example, models that reason over large spatial context (an entire site, not just a tile) where a standard fixed-resolution detector falls short.


Integrate models into the product end to end. A model isn't done when the metric looks good — it's done when it's running on real data in the platform and making the team or the customer faster.


Choose problems and approaches based on business impact — what actually moves the needle for our products and operations.





What success looks like after 6–12 months:





Your models are running in production on real data, moving the metrics our customers and operations teams care about.


The MLOps backbone is solid — training is reproducible, experiments are tracked, and shipping a new model is routine, not a fire drill.


A feedback loop runs from labeled operations data back into training, so the models keep getting better on their own cadence.


Throughput across model work, training runs, and dataset iteration is meaningfully higher than when you started.


AI is unblocking the roadmap, not bottlenecking it — the gaps we hired you to close are closed.



Requirements



Strong applied computer vision / deep learning experience — you've trained, fine-tuned, and debugged CV models, not just called APIs, and you understand what's happening inside them.


Hands-on with the experimental loop: dataset curation, augmentation, training, error analysis, iteration. When results are bad, you know how to diagnose why.


A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset — you reason about how a model will actually be used, what "good enough" means for the business, and the shortest path to a real result.


Strong fundamentals and clean engineering instincts. You write code meant to live in production — readable, testable, maintainable — not just notebook scratch.


Motivated to grow into the integration and MLOps side, and comfortable touching code beyond the model itself. (You don't need to be a senior full-stack engineer on day one.)


High intelligence and learning velocity — we care more about how you think and how fast you grow than years on a CV.


Comfortable working in English in a small, fast-moving team.





Big plus:





Aerial / drone / remote-sensing imagery (orthomosaics, geo-referencing, multi-band, large images).


Non-visual imagery (thermal, multispectral).


Detection, segmentation, keypoint, or multi-scale architectures applied to large or high-resolution images.


Production MLOps: experiment tracking, reproducible training, model registries, monitoring.


Full-stack experience (Python, TypeScript, React, Postgres) — you'll get plenty of chances to use it.


Weakly- or self-supervised learning, active-learning loops.



Benefits



Real impact, fast: a clearly identified gap, a concrete roadmap, and customers waiting on the results. Your models will ship.


Breadth: from datasets and model work through MLOps and into product integration — you'll grow across the stack as much as you want.


A strategic seat: AI is central to where Sitemark is going, and you'll help shape that direction, not just execute on it.


A pragmatic culture: we care about results, not theatre — the boring solution when it works, the hard one when it doesn't.


Work on a mission that matters: accelerating the world's transition to renewable energy.


Competitive compensation including meaningful equity (stock options) with real upside.


Remote-friendly within Central European time zones — we have team members across Belgium and Poland, and we're open to additional locations with enough overlap with CET hours.

  • Strong applied computer vision / deep learning experience — you've trained, fine-tuned, and debugged CV models, not just called APIs, and you understand what's happening inside them.

  • Hands-on with the experimental loop: dataset curation, augmentation, training, error analysis, iteration. When results are bad, you know how to diagnose why.

  • A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset — you reason about how a model will actually be used, what "good enough" means for the business, and the shortest path to a real result.

  • Strong fundamentals and clean engineering instincts. You write code meant to live in production — readable, testable, maintainable — not just notebook scratch.

  • Motivated to grow into the integration and MLOps side, and comfortable touching code beyond the model itself. (You don't need to be a senior full-stack engineer on day one.)

  • High intelligence and learning velocity — we care more about how you think and how fast you grow than years on a CV.

  • Comfortable working in English in a small, fast-moving team.


Big plus:



  • Aerial / drone / remote-sensing imagery (orthomosaics, geo-referencing, multi-band, large images).

  • Non-visual imagery (thermal, multispectral).

  • Detection, segmentation, keypoint, or multi-scale architectures applied to large or high-resolution images.

  • Production MLOps: experiment tracking, reproducible training, model registries, monitoring.

  • Full-stack experience (Python, TypeScript, React, Postgres) — you'll get plenty of chances to use it.

  • Weakly- or self-supervised learning, active-learning loops.


Benefits

  • Real impact, fast: a clearly identified gap, a concrete roadmap, and customers waiting on the results. Your models will ship.

  • Breadth: from datasets and model work through MLOps and into product integration — you'll grow across the stack as much as you want.

  • A strategic seat: AI is central to where Sitemark is going, and you'll help shape that direction, not just execute on it.

  • A pragmatic culture: we care about results, not theatre — the boring solution when it works, the hard one when it doesn't.

  • Work on a mission that matters: accelerating the world's transition to renewable energy.

  • Competitive compensation including meaningful equity (stock options) with real upside.

  • Remote-friendly within Central European time zones — we have team members across Belgium and Poland, and we're open to additional locations with enough overlap with CET hours.

Title: AI ENGINEER / ML ENGINEER
Description:
Beschrijving

In deze functie ben je vanaf het begin betrokken bij AI- en data-gedreven projecten en draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor zowel de analytische als de technische kant. Je analyseert klantvragen en de beschikbare data en vertaalt deze naar realistische en waardevolle oplossingen, nog voordat development start.

Op basis daarvan bepaal je de algemene aanpak en strategie. Je kiest de juiste AI- en machine learning-methoden, brengt risico’s en afhankelijkheden in kaart en ontwerpt de MVP en roadmap. Hoewel je de software niet zelf bouwt, werk je nauw samen met Data Scientists, AI Engineers en Software Engineers om ervoor te zorgen dat de oplossingen haalbaar, schaalbaar en klaar voor productie zijn.

Je werkt met moderne AI-technologieën zoals machine learning, generatieve AI en computer vision. Daarnaast begrijp je hoe datapijplijnen en ETL-processen training en implementatie ondersteunen. Door helder te communiceren stem je klanten en teams goed af op verwachtingen, mogelijkheden en beperkingen, en leg je een sterke basis voor hoogwaardige en toekomstbestendige AI-oplossingen.

Technology stack

Je gaat mogelijk aan de slag met technologieën en/of methodologieën zoals:

Cloud platforms (Azure / AWS)

Natural Language Processing (Text Classification, Clustering algorithms)

Generative AI (LLMs, RAG pipelines, Agentic AI)

Python (FastAPI, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, OpenCV)

Computer Vision (Object Detection, Image Segmentation, Image Classification)

MLOps (Docker, CI/CD)

Onze werkwijze: Agile / Scrum

We zijn op zoek naar een AI Engineer die zich richt op data science en die graag de leiding neemt in complexe AI-projecten en duidelijke richting kan geven.

Title: Applied Machine Learning Engineer - IoT
Description:
Your role

Do you want to apply machine learning and signal processing to real industrial equipment operating worldwide? Join our Applied Machine Intelligence & IoT team and help transform data from more than 250,000 connected compressors into smart-maintenance and optimization solutions that create measurable customer value.

Is your ideal day one where you combine signal processing, machine learning, and a genuine curiosity about mechanical systems to build models that make real machines run better? Then you might be the perfect fit for our Applied Machine Intelligence & IoT team.

As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer in the Applied Machine Intelligence team (part of the Aftermarket R&D organization), you will turn sensor and machine data from our connected products into optimization and smart-maintenance models that deliver measurable value to our customers. You'll work across our global connectivity ecosystem and help bring proven optimization and uptime algorithms into our SMARTLINK AI platform.

As an Applied Machine Learning Engineer, you will analyze vibration, temperature, pressure, and operational data using both time-domain and frequency-domain techniques. By leveraging machine learning methodologies such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, classification, clustering, and forecasting, you will extract valuable insights from equipment data and translate them into actionable improvements.

You will be responsible for developing and enhancing models focused on energy efficiency, performance optimization, and smart maintenance for our connected product portfolio. In addition, you will integrate, validate, and deploy optimization algorithms within the Smart Events engine and the broader connectivity platform, ensuring that insights are effectively translated into customer value.

Working across the entire connectivity ecosystem, you will take an end-to-end approach, spanning from physical equipment and controllers to the generation of insights and the delivery of tangible business value to customers. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues from engineering, marketing, and operations to shape product roadmaps and deliver comprehensive solutions that address customer and business needs.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our approach for many positions is “hire for attitude and train for skill.” We support people through learning, coaching and on-the-job training. Do you only partly meet the profile below? No problem, we still encourage you to apply.


You hold a master's degree in engineering (Electronics, Computer Science, or equivalent)
You're skilled in Python, PySpark, Databricks, Pandas, Scikit-learn, MLflow
You have hands-on experience with, or a strong interest in, signal processing and machine learning applied to sensor data
You have a strong interest in mechanical systems (compressors, dryers, chillers or similar) and are eager to dive deeper into the domain
You enjoy working in diverse, international teams and are comfortable collaborating across functions
You are a problem-solver with a passion for innovation and a drive to continuously improve


In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

You bring the following qualities & experiences to the role:

A deep passion for Artificial Intelligence and its applications.
A minimum of 2 years of experience developing AI-driven applications or systems.
Strong foundation in software design principles; Proficiency in Python & SQL is a must.
A solid understanding of core machine learning techniques and how to apply them pragmatically in production settings.
Familiarity with modern generative AI and agentic approaches, including retrieval-based systems and LLM orchestration patterns.
Experience deploying AI systems into production, with a solid grasp of model lifecycle management and cloud-native deployment practices.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and a solid understanding of cloud-based AI and data workflows.
Front-end experience is considered a plus.
Strong communication skills and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for clients.
A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset: able to translate business problems into technical scopes and help AI solutions land, with a focus on product thinking and real business value.
Fluency in English and Dutch.

As part of the Talan Group, we further extend these opportunities by offering an international dimension to your career path.

+ High-end laptop

+ Meal vouchers

+ ...

Diverse and welcoming work environment, where you’ll collaborate & unwind with colleagues from different cultures and disciplines. The organization of both fun & professional events and initiatives is actively encouraged and supported.

SquareDev is a member of the QnR Group, a leading technology organization specializing in end-to-end custom software solutions, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business One, ServiceNow, and FinTech solutions.

As part of QnR Group's ongoing expansion — both in Greece and internationally — we are continuously hiring across a wide range of tech roles. Successful candidates may be hired by QnR Group, or another company within the Group, depending on the role and project.

We are looking for an Engineer to join one of our EU public sector clients based in Brussels. You'll will contribute to the design, development, and deployment of core platform components, focusing on data engineering, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities. The role requires a strong ability to work across structured and unstructured data, enabling reporting and advanced analytical and AI use cases.

Requirements

The ideal candidate will be responsible for:


Building and maintaining data pipelines integrating heterogeneous structured and unstructured sources, including batch and near-real-time ingestion
Performing data cleansing, validation, standardization, metadata tagging, and supporting data lineage across data flows
Contributing to the Data and Product Catalogue and implementing data quality checks and monitoring
Designing solutions that combine structured data (databases, tabular datasets) with unstructured data (documents, reports, text) into reusable data products
Supporting AI-driven processing of document-centric data and contributing to AI-enabled use cases with explainability, traceability, and human-in-the-loop controls
Automating pipelines and reporting workflows, and implementing event-driven processing, alerts, and monitoring
Implementing security controls (IAM, encryption at rest/in transit, audit logging) and supporting separation of classified/unclassified and secure or air-gapped environments
Building modular, scalable platform components using open standards/APIs, and supporting integration with existing EDA systems


To excel in this role, you'll need:


Proven experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and working with data lake/warehouse architectures (Microsoft Fabric, Azure ecosystem, or open-source platforms)
Demonstrated experience integrating structured data (databases, tabular) with unstructured data (documents, PDFs, text corpora) end-to-end
Experience in analytics development, data modelling, and exposure to AI/ML on text/document-based data, with understanding of explainability and traceability
Knowledge of DevOps, Git, CI/CD, and pipeline automation; ability to work in multi-stakeholder environments
Strong English communication skills.

SquareDev? 🐿️

We use state-of-the-art technology to build solutions for our customers and our partners' customers. We make sure we stay best-in-class by participating in research projects across Europe, collaborating with top universities and enterprises on AI, Data, and Cloud.

About QnR Group

SquareDev is a member of the QnR Group, a leading technology organization specializing in end-to-end custom software solutions, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business One, ServiceNow, and FinTech solutions.

As part of QnR Group's ongoing expansion — both in Greece and internationally — we are continuously hiring across a wide range of tech roles. Successful candidates may be hired by QnR Group, or another company within the Group, depending on the role and project.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Engineer to join one of our EU public sector clients based in Brussels. You'll will contribute to the design, development, and deployment of core platform components, focusing on data engineering, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities. The role requires a strong ability to work across structured and unstructured data, enabling reporting and advanced analytical and AI use cases.

Requirements

The ideal candidate will be responsible for:

  • Building and maintaining data pipelines integrating heterogeneous structured and unstructured sources, including batch and near-real-time ingestion
  • Performing data cleansing, validation, standardization, metadata tagging, and supporting data lineage across data flows
  • Contributing to the Data and Product Catalogue and implementing data quality checks and monitoring
  • Designing solutions that combine structured data (databases, tabular datasets) with unstructured data (documents, reports, text) into reusable data products
  • Supporting AI-driven processing of document-centric data and contributing to AI-enabled use cases with explainability, traceability, and human-in-the-loop controls
  • Automating pipelines and reporting workflows, and implementing event-driven processing, alerts, and monitoring
  • Implementing security controls (IAM, encryption at rest/in transit, audit logging) and supporting separation of classified/unclassified and secure or air-gapped environments
  • Building modular, scalable platform components using open standards/APIs, and supporting integration with existing EDA systems

To excel in this role, you'll need:

  • Proven experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and working with data lake/warehouse architectures (Microsoft Fabric, Azure ecosystem, or open-source platforms)
  • Demonstrated experience integrating structured data (databases, tabular) with unstructured data (documents, PDFs, text corpora) end-to-end
  • Experience in analytics development, data modelling, and exposure to AI/ML on text/document-based data, with understanding of explainability and traceability
  • Knowledge of DevOps, Git, CI/CD, and pipeline automation; ability to work in multi-stakeholder environments
  • Strong English communication skills.

Title: Market & Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a medior profile with proficient coding skills but mainly with strong interest and knowledge in the energy sector, that is interested by the energy transition and that will help the team getting the right data infrastructure and tools as well as support in performing and analyzing the appropriate simulations to deliver state-of-the-art studies needed to plan the energy transition. We’re looking for someone who will always questioned the scenarios data, someone able and willing to challenge projections (concerning evolution of PV, wind, H2 thermal units,…) for BE or other EU main countries, able and willing to estimate if those are rather ambitious or realistic,…).

Elia Is Therefore Looking For The Support Of a Specialized Service With Expert Knowledge On Data Analysis (data Mining, Data Gathering/processing (in VBA, Excel, R/Python), Data Visualization) And Energy Systems Scenarios. The Consultant Will Help To Perform Different Tasks In Different Projects Within The SMA Team


Use, and when possible improve, data management processes at SMA.
Contribute, and when possible improve, data collection processes and definition – creation of scenarios and model building datasets.
Support the model building, including quality checks on the built models.
Support on the impact assessment of (some parts of ) the model building (e.g. the demand assumptions, renewables assumptions, flexibility and storage assumptions..) as well as quality checks on the models and results after simulations.


Example of tasks

A non-exhaustive list of tasks (and description) is given below:


Consolidate historical data into an model input data set.
Collect projection scenarios from EU countries, and challenge the data, ensure those are in line with defined storylines;
Create & review tools in R/Python/VBA/Excel in order to input/change different parameters or data items in the model or simulation ANTARES tool;
Be able to use and improve, create visualisations of the outputs of simulations (in R, Power BI, Qgis, …)
Critically analyze results of algorithms, assist in the identification of key trends
Data engineering and interfaces between tools
Other tasks (not yet defined)


Requirements

Hard skills


R or Python


(must have)


R is extensively used in existing tools at SMA. However new tools are rather developed now in Python. Hence, proficiency in one of the two is a must, but experience with both is a plus.


Excel

(‘must have’)

and VBA

(‘nice to have’)


Excel and VBA are used to conduct analyses or as interface for R/python scripts. It is one of the ways the team explores data (up to a certain size). Many of the databases used by SMA are stored in Excel format.


ANTARES (mainly the input/output interface but also a general knowledge of economic dispatch tool is a

‘nice to have’


ANTARES is an economic dispatch tool developed by RTE, the French TSO. In the application’s core is an economic dispatch tool for the electricity market. Antares allows to simulate the electricity market on an hourly basis.
The tool needs to be fed with input data and given the large quantity of data generated by the simulator (depending on the study, more than 10 GB per simulation), several scripts and spreadsheets were developed to input, retrieve data and analyse it.
Any experience with market simulations can be valued here.


Soft Skills


Medior profile: 3 yrs experience minimum.
You have knowledge of and strong interest in the energy market;
You are able to work independently and in a team;
You have an analytical and innovative mind;
Fluent level of Dutch and/or French and English is required.

Title: Medior AI Engineer
Description:
Are you passionate about #AI or #cybersecurity? You love working with high profile teams with a sure taste for challenge and variety? You dream to join a fast-growing company with start-up mentality? Eager to learn continuously? Join Proximus Ada! Within Proximus’ centre of excellence for AI and Cybersecurity, a team of data scientists, data engineers and analytics translators, supports the Proximus group in designing, developing and deploying internal AI-driven applications in line with the business needs.

As a Medior AI Engineer, you will play a key role in developing end-to-end solutions for AI use cases. By taking up a use case right from the start you will help our customers define and scope the problem, pick the right ML solution and technology as well as ensure implementation, integration and deployment of your solution to production. You will do so while ensuring that our internal governance processes, technical excellence and best practices are respected. You will also collaborate with other team members in knowledge sharing as well as continuously improving our way of working.

Responsibilities


Develop AI applications using state-of-the-art (Gen)AI technology.
Translate business requests into AI applications.
Pilot prototypes in production processes to demonstrate their value.
Deploy prototypes to production to obtain reliable, scalable systems.
Present your results in a clear manner and discuss them with multi-functional project teams.
Work in close collaboration with business experts (e.g. for requirement gathering, data source identification, data and process understanding, feature engineering, result validation, etc.), and with other AI engineers in the team (e.g.forknowledgesharing).


Profile


PhD or Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Proven experience (2+ years) in AI/ML engineering with a strong focus on deploying and integrating AI


Technical Skills


Strong expertise in Python
Strong knowledge of state-of-the-art AI and statistical methods
Proven proficiency with deploying scalable AI applications to production
Experience using LLM’s and commonly used libraries to interact with LLM’s (Langchain, Llamaindex, ...)
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, and Azure Data & AI services
Strong Expertise with version control (Git, GitHub)
Expertise with CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development best practices
Experience with Agentic AI frameworks (Langgraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, …) is a big plus
Experience with MLOps tools and frameworks (g. MLflow, Kubeflow, TFX) is a big plus


Attitudes/Behavior


Excellent problem-solving skills.
Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse stakeholders from data science, engineering, and business units.
Excellence: Strong commitment to excellence by consistently striving for high-quality outcomes, embracing continuous improvement, and maintaining a proactive, detail-oriented approach in all tasks.
Innovation Mindset: Willingness to explore new technologies and methodologies to drive continuous improvement.
Resilience: Capacity to troubleshoot and resolve issues in complex changing environments while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
Communication: Ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and provide clear documentation.


Languages


Fluent in English + French and/or Dutch

Title: Data Engineer - GenAI
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Build the Foundation of AI and Data Transformation

Are you an experienced Data Engineer with a passion for building high-performance data pipelines and scalable cloud architectures for the Generative AI era? Artefact Belgium is looking for a Data Engineer to drive innovation and deliver robust data foundations for our global clients. If you have a solid track record in data engineering and consulting, we invite you to shape the future of AI-driven solutions with us in Brussels.

Who We Are

Founded in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm specializing in data, analytics, and AI, focused on transforming data into business impact. We help clients grow their data and digital capabilities while growing ourselves. Our engineering team in Belgium works on the most advanced applications of data technology, from large-scale data platforms to supporting state-of-the-art GenAI projects. Our inclusive and forward-thinking culture encourages creativity, collaboration, and professional growth.

What You Will Do

As a Data Engineer in our GenAI practice, you will own the end-to-end execution of complex technical challenges. You won't just "move" data; you will build the specialized infrastructure and data flywheels that power the next generation of Generative AI, RAG systems, and autonomous agents.


Deploy GenAI-Ready Production Pipelines: Design and deploy advanced data pipelines both batch and streaming optimized for processing unstructured data (text, images, audio) to fuel LLM fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented generation.
Build Scalable AI Platforms & Vector DBs: Hands-on development using modern cloud platforms like Databricks, Azure, or AWS.
Establish Engineering Excellence for LLMs: Implement best practices in data transformation (dbt), orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster), and data governance to ensure that AI solutions are reliable, safe, and compliant at enterprise scale.
Collaborate on AI Innovation: Work closely with Machine Learning Engineers and Generative AI Specialists to design data models and "data-as-a-service" layers that enable rapid prototyping and scaling of AI agents.
Software Engineering Foundation: Advocate for clean, maintainable code using Python, SQL, and Git, and leverage containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) to deploy AI-driven microservices.


Who You Are


Experienced Professional: At least 3-5 years of industry experience in data engineering, ideally within a consulting environment, with exposure to data preparation for AI/ML.
Deep Technical Skillset: Strong programming skills in Python and proven expertise in Spark (PySpark, SparkSQL) for large-scale data processing and feature engineering.
Data Transformation Expert: Extensive experience with dbt for data modeling, and a strong curiosity about emerging patterns in "LLMOps" and vector data management.
Consulting Mindset: Proven ability to navigate multidisciplinary environments and communicate how high-quality data architecture is the primary bottleneck for successful GenAI deployment.
Education: A Master’s in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field).
Linguistic Versatility: Proficiency in English is required; fluency in Dutch or French is a major advantage for our Belgian market.


What We Offer


Competitive Compensation: An attractive package aligned with your expertise, including a mobility budget or company car and premium insurance.
High-Impact Opportunities: Work with state-of-the-art technologies on global projects that transform the world's leading brands through Generative AI.
Professional Growth: Access to a substantial training budget for individual learning, research into new AI frameworks, and certifications.
A Collaborative Workplace: Join a diverse team where fun and professional excellence go hand-in-hand, with access to 2,000+ colleagues across 34 global offices.


This position is based in Brussels, At Artefact Belgium, we value expertise, curiosity, and a drive to innovate. If you're ready to build the data engines of the AI future, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Analyst – Energy Scenarios & Market Modelling
Description:
Our client is a leading European Transmission System Operator (TSO) responsible for ensuring a reliable, sustainable and secure electricity supply. Within the organisation, the Scenarios, Market & Adequacy Analysis team is responsible for conducting long-term security of supply studies, energy vision studies and cost-benefit analyses for future Grid developments. These studies rely on advanced electricity market modelling and simulation tools to assess future electricity demand, generation capacity and overall system adequacy.

As a Data Analyst, you will support the SMA team in developing future energy scenarios and the modelling frameworks used to study Belgium's and Europe's future electricity system.

This is a highly analytical role combining data analysis, programming and energy market expertise. You'll help build and validate datasets, develop analytical tools, improve data processes and support electricity market simulations used to plan the energy transition.

The client is looking for someone who is both an "energy geek" and a "data geek"—someone who enjoys working with data but is equally interested in understanding how the future electricity system will evolve.

Your responsibilities


Support the development of future energy scenarios for Belgium and Europe.
Build scenarios covering future electricity demand, electric vehicles (Ev), heat pumps (HP), industrial demand, renewable energy sources (RES), thermal generation, flexibility and Storage.
Collect, consolidate and validate large volumes of historical and projected energy data from multiple sources.
Gather projection data from European countries and critically assess whether assumptions are realistic and aligned with defined energy scenarios.
Develop, improve and maintain data collection, data management and scenario-building processes.
Create and maintain datasets used by electricity market modelling tools.
Support model building and perform quality checks on datasets and models.
Assess the impact of modelling assumptions, including demand, renewable production, flexibility and Storage.
Develop and improve tools in Python, R, Excel and VBA.
Create visualisations and analyse simulation outputs using tools such as Power BI, R or QGIS.
Analyse algorithm results, identify trends and support interpretation of simulation outcomes.
Support data engineering activities and interfaces between different tools and systems.
Contribute to improving the team's analytical tools and overall way of working.


What we're looking for


Minimum 3 years of relevant experience (medior level).
Strong programming skills in Python or R (experience with both is a plus).
Strong Excel skills.
Experience with data analysis, data mining, data gathering, processing and visualization.
Knowledge of, or a strong interest in, the Belgian and European energy market.
Genuine interest in the energy transition and future energy systems.
Ability to critically challenge data, assumptions and projections rather than simply processing them.
Analytical, proactive and innovative mindset.
Able to work independently as well as collaboratively.
Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with good English.


Nice To Have


VBA.
Experience with ANTARES or another electricity market simulation/economic dispatch tool.
Experience with electricity market simulations.
Experience with Power BI and/or QGIS.
Data engineering experience.


Technical Environment

As a Data Analyst, you will support the SMA team in developing future energy scenarios and the modelling frameworks used to study Belgium's and Europe's future electricity system.

This is a highly analytical role combining data analysis, programming and energy market expertise. You'll help build and validate datasets, develop analytical tools, improve data processes and support electricity market simulations used to plan the energy transition.

Title: Data engineer- Databricks
Description:
Position Description

Are you a data enthusiast eager to design and optimize cutting-edge data architectures? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where your expertise can drive real business impact? Do you want to contribute to the energy transition with innovative data solutions and help our clients become data-driven organizations?

Your role in our team

✅ Design, implement, and maintain scalable data architectures using databases, AWS data lakes, and data warehouses.

✅ Develop and optimize ETL pipelines to seamlessly integrate data from multiple sources.

✅ Create unified, gold-standard data sources for analysis and reporting.

✅ Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and quality throughout its lifecycle.

✅ Manage and optimize data infrastructure for efficiency, storage, and cost-effectiveness.

✅ Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure scalability, security, and performance of data systems.

✅ Build and maintain automated data processing pipelines using Python, Spark, and SQL.

✅ Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand and implement data-driven solutions.

✅ Document data architectures, pipelines, and processes for seamless knowledge sharing.

✅ Promote and apply best practices in data engineering across IT and business teams.

How You Strengthen Our Team

✅ 5-7 years of proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer or in a similar role

✅ Strong expertise in Data Platform Management

✅ Hands-on experience with AWS services (S3, Athena, Glue, Redshift)

✅ Experience with Databricks (preferably on AWS)

✅ Strong programming skills in Python, Spark, SQL, or other data engineering languages

✅ Experience with data processing technologies

✅ Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)

✅ Knowledge of DataIku for advanced analytics and automation

✅ Experience with Azure DevOps & release pipelines

✅ AWS Certification in Cloud Data Engineering is a plus!

Good to Have:

➕ Experience in the utilities market

➕ Knowledge of technical systems like Salesforce, SAP ISU

➕ Familiarity with Agile tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira

➕ Understanding of financial closing reports

➕ Additional AWS certifications (Solution Architect, Systems Administrator)

Soft Skills:

Team player who thrives in a collaborative, multicultural environment

Strong communication skills, especially in translating technical concepts for nontechnical business leaders

Adaptability to evolving technologies and changing project requirements

Proven organizational skills and keen attention to detail

Native Dutch or French with good communication in English

Education : Bachelor or master degree with a focus on Information Technology, or equivalent

A pre-employment screening is part of the application process

Why CGI?

CGI is one of the world's largest IT consultancy companies. Our people keep Belgium running. Government institutions, banks, infrastructure organization's, energy and utilities, manufacturing and life sciences companies are CGI's clients . We work on interesting projects that touch the everyday lives of millions of people. We have a regional presence, reinforced with global domain expertise, our ecosystem and colleagues spread across the globe.

We are proud of the impactful projects we make a success together with our colleagues.

At CGI, we value diversity and inclusion as it not only promotes collaboration, but also often leads to better results. We look forward to your contribution to our team!

Working in small self-managing teams consisting of experts in your field.


Directing your own career with the space to keep developing yourself.
You work with the latest technologies.
An excellent salary and attractive fringe benefits
An immediate permanent contract
And the opportunity to become a CGI shareholder


Join our team of experts and apply now!

Questions about the position? Ask them to Ramiro Santos, VP Consulting Services, Private sector, via ramiro.santos@cgi.com.

For more information about the application procedure, please contact recruiter Nick Damen nick.damen@cgi.com

We do not collaborate with external recruitment agencies. Therefore, unsolicited acquisition is not appreciated.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
WHO IS EDENRED?




Edenred is the global leader in Benefits & Engagement and Mobility. With more than 1 million client companies across 44 countries, Edenred's platform gives more than 60 million users access to the services and products of more than 2 million partner merchants. Edenred offers digital solutions dedicated to employees (meal vouchers, commuting, gift cards, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers), fleet managers (multi-energy solutions including EV charging, maintenance services, tolls, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards).




'Enrich connections. For good.'

Guided by the Group's purpose, these solutions enhance employees' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers. They promote access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. Finally, they improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses while vitalizing the employment market and local economies. Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day. In 2025, thanks to its unique technology platform, the Group generated a business volume of €49 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms, and cards. Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index and DJSI World Index.







YOU WILL VIBE WITH US




As part of Edenred BeLux, you will be working as Data Analyst in our Tech Data Team.

The main scope of Data Team is to create data products on our Global Edenred Azure Data Platform, build data sets, provide strategic dashboard & reports in Power BI and enable self-service reporting across the organization/

As a Data Analyst, you are a professional specialized in the design, implementation, and management of the systems, architecture, and tools necessary for the collection, storage, transformation, and distribution of data. The primary role of a Data Analyst is to develop and maintain the infrastructure that allows business teams to organize and efficiently exploit their data.




The key stakeholders for this position are:




Internal: End-users & key users, Data & Product managers and executives, process owners/team leaders and managers, Agile Teams (Scrum Masters and Product Owners).
External: HQ’s corporate IT, Remote Development centers, customers and partners.
Reporting Line : you report directly to the IT Back-end & Data Product Owner and your N+2 will be the CTO Edenred BeLux.




As a Data Analyst, you will be in charge of Collecting & organizing the data on an efficient, compliant & secured way (pricing analytics, client/merchant segmentation, Business Review reporting,…) :




Business analysis & modelling: understanding, documenting, supporting, and analyzing procedures that support the business functions performed in the different departments of the company.
Data management: Takes responsibility for the accessibility, retrievability and security of specific subsets of data
Data visualization: develop reports & dashboards in PowerBI or other Data Visualization tools
Requirements definition & management: defining user stories and acceptance criteria with the key users, Product Owners, Product Managers and Business Sponsors.
Development & implementation: participate actively with the dev. team, lead the validation efforts with the end users and proactively help the team members with their tasks to finish each Sprint.
Application support & Customer service support: As a team, take full responsibility of changes put into production
The quality of the deliverables: testing Business Process & applications.







WE WILL VIBE WITH YOU




You have at least 3 years of experience in business analysis and/or business process management. Ideally, you have experience in financial services industry or gained in a consultancy environment or similar.
You are fluent in French and/or Dutch and English.
You have proficiency in PowerBI (and/or Tableau) including DAX and SQL.
You feel comfortable with statistical data analysis:
Analysis of information from a data dashboard
Knowledge of data exploration statistical methods
Conducting tests to confirm hypotheses
Data quality assessment through statistical analysis
You can convert business requirements into tasks and implement them in the analysis process.
You have at least a basic understanding of data security and legislation (GDPR) and data collection and management (formulation of collection needs based on field-specific issues and data modeling, extraction of relevant data from large volumes).
You demonstrate analytical and synthesis capacities, communication and presentation skills, capacity to lead through challenging situations and customer orientation.




At Edenred, we recognize, recruit, and develop all talents while respecting each individual's uniqueness.

We encourage and consider all applications without distinction of origin, gender, identity or expression of gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other protected criteria as defined by Unia.







START DATE

ASAP







OTHER INFORMATION

Permanent contract (38 hours/week).
Location: Brussels (Auderghem).
A stimulating position within a dynamic organization that focuses on technological innovation to enhance workers' purchasing power.
The opportunity to work remotely 2 days a week with your manager's approval, including a homeworking allowance of 115€.
You are covered with hospitalization and ambulatory care insurance (with the option to extend it to your family).
You benefit from all Edenred-solutions, such as vouchers but also Edenred Engagement (including Edenred Discounts).
Your package includes a car or a mobility budget, depending on what you prefer.

Sobre o Bradesco

A gente acredita no poder da confiança. Confiança que aproxima, orienta e transforma a vida das pessoas no dia a dia. Entrar no Bradesco é fazer parte de um momento real de transformação. Um ambiente que combina a solidez de uma história construída ao longo de décadas com a evolução constante de quem está sempre olhando para frente. Aqui, você encontra espaço para aprender, crescer e assumir protagonismo na sua trajetória, com apoio, estrutura e oportunidades que acompanham o seu desenvolvimento. Mais do que trabalhar em uma grande instituição, é sobre fazer parte de um time que impacta milhões de pessoas, contribui para o desenvolvimento do país e constrói, todos os dias, um futuro mais acessível e sustentável para a sociedade.

Sobre a área

CRM: Gerencia estratégias de relacionamento com clientes por meio do uso de dados e inteligência analítica. Atua na segmentação de públicos e na personalização de ofertas, comunicações e jornadas, maximizando relevância e engajamento. Contribui para aquisição, fidelização e crescimento, apoiando decisões comerciais e a evolução da experiência do cliente.

Como será seu dia a dia?

Como Data Scientist II, você atuará na área de Cluster de Modelos e suas principais atividades serão:



Desenvolver modelos de Machine Learning.
Desenvolver modelos estatísticos.
Construir modelos de propensão.
Construir modelos de classificação.
Desenvolver modelos de segmentação.
Desenvolver modelos de recomendação.
Realizar análises exploratórias (EDA).
Desenvolver pipelines de dados.



Modelo de trabalho

Híbrido - 1x Presencial

Unidade: Osasco - SP

Perfil que buscamos

Valorizamos quem entende o cliente em profundidade, trabalha em parceria e transforma conhecimento em entregas com impacto. Profissionais com senso de dono, consistência na execução e foco em resultado, que evoluem continuamente, compartilham aprendizados e usam tecnologia para transformar desafios em soluções relevantes para o negócio.

Requisitos



Graduação completa em Ciências de Dados, Ciências Contábeis, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Engenharia, Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
Python.
SQL.
SAS.
Databricks.
Conhecimento em Machine Learning.
Experiência com desenvolvimento de modelos analíticos.

Ferramentas de BI (Power BI ou Tableau).

Working closely with colleagues across Brazil, India, and the United States, you will apply analytical rigor, critical thinking, and effective challenge to assess model performance, identify risks, and strengthen model governance. Join a team that is passionate about ensuring models and data are used responsibly to support sound business decisions and effective risk management practices.

Main Responsibilities

  • Perform validation activities for models covering areas including Credit Risk, Treasury, Accounting, Sales and Marketing;

  • Perform validation of traditional statistical models as well as machine learning and GenAI-based analytical solutions;
  • Evaluate compliance of models with internal Model Risk Management policies and regulatory expectations;
  • Assess model limitations, risks, controls, and business usage to ensure appropriate governance and risk mitigation.

  • Experience with statistical modelling and data management tools such as Python, R, Databricks and SAS;

  • Commitment to team success and a proactive, collaborative approach to problem solving and different cultures and time zones;
  • Good communication and teamwork skills;
  • Availability for on-site work at the headquarters in Indaiatuba, SP.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Master's, PhD or specialization in Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience performing independent model reviews, conceptual soundness assessments, and outcome analysis;
  • Understanding of SR 11-7 ,SR 26-2, CECL requirement and model validation practices;
  • Understanding of model lifecycle management, model risk governance, and validation frameworks;
